sentences.zh: 資治通鑑第051卷

translations.literal: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 51.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi Tongjian, Volume 51.

sentences.zh: 【漢紀四十三】起旃蒙赤奮若，盡昭陽作噩，凡九年。

translations.literal: 【Han Records 43】 From Zhanmeng Chifenruo through Zhaoyang Zuo'e—in all, nine years.
translations.idiomatic: 【Han Records 43】 From the first year of the Zhanmeng cycle through the last year of the Zhaoyang cycle—nine years in all.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，乙亥，下邳惠王衍薨。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on the day yihai, Prince Hui of Xiapi Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on yihai day, Prince Hui of Xiapi Yan died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕南巡。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the imperial carriage made a southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the emperor made a southern tour.

sentences.zh: 三月，戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon of the day wuwu, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of wuwu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝至宛，不豫。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the emperor reached Wan and was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the emperor reached Wan and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，帝發自宛；

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the emperor set out from Wan;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the emperor set out from Wan;

sentences.zh: 丁卯，至葉，崩於乘輿。

translations.literal: on the day dingmao, he reached Ye and died in the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: on dingmao day he reached Ye and died in the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 年三十二。

translations.literal: His age was thirty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He was thirty-two years old.

sentences.zh: 皇后與閻顯兄弟、江京、樊豐等謀曰：「今晏駕道次，濟陰王在內，邂逅公卿立之，還為大害。

translations.literal: The empress, together with Yan Xian's brothers, Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and the rest, plotted, saying, "Now the carriage rests by the way; the Prince of Jibei is within the palace. Should the grand ministers by chance install him, on return it will become a great harm."
translations.idiomatic: The empress, together with Yan Xian's brothers, Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and the rest, plotted, saying, "The emperor has died on the road, and the Prince of Jibei is in the palace. If the grand ministers by chance install him, on our return it will be a great disaster."

sentences.zh: 」乃偽云「帝疾甚」，徙御臥車，所在上食、問起居如故。

translations.literal: " They thereupon falsely announced "the emperor's illness is severe," moved him to the imperial sleeping carriage, and at each place food was presented and inquiries after his health continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: " They thereupon falsely announced that "the emperor's illness is severe," moved him to the imperial sleeping carriage, and at each stop food was presented and inquiries after his health continued as before.

sentences.zh: 驅馳行四日，庚午，還宮。

translations.literal: They drove in haste for four days; on the day gengwu they returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: They drove in haste for four days; on gengwu day they returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣司徒劉熹詣郊廟、社稷，告天請命；

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Minister of Education Liu Xi was sent to the suburban altars, temples, and altars of soil and grain to announce to Heaven and request mandate;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Minister of Education Liu Xi was sent to the suburban altars, temples, and the altars of soil and grain to announce to Heaven and request mandate;

sentences.zh: 其夕，發喪。

translations.literal: that evening the mourning was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: that evening mourning was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 尊皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝。

translations.literal: The empress dowager presided over court.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager presided over court.

sentences.zh: 以顯為車騎將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Xian was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Xian was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 太后欲久專國政，貪立幼年，與顯等定策禁中，迎濟北惠王子北鄉侯懿為嗣。

translations.literal: The empress dowager wished to monopolize state affairs for long, was greedy to install a young child, and with Xian and the rest fixed the succession within the Forbidden Quarter, welcoming Prince Hui of Jibei's son, Marquis of North Village Yi, as heir.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager wished to monopolize state affairs for long and was eager to install a young child. With Xian and the rest she fixed the succession within the inner palace and welcomed Prince Hui of Jibei's son, Marquis of North Village Yi, as heir.

sentences.zh: 濟陰王以廢黜，不得上殿親臨梓宮，悲號不食；

translations.literal: The Prince of Jibei, because he was deposed and dismissed, could not ascend the hall to attend the coffin in person, wailed in grief and would not eat;
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Jibei, having been deposed, could not ascend the hall to attend the coffin in person. He wailed in grief and would not eat;

sentences.zh: 內外群僚莫不哀之。

translations.literal: within and without, the host of officials none failed to grieve for him.
translations.idiomatic: officials within and without all grieved for him.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，濟南孝王香薨，無子，國絕。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Prince Xiao of Jinan Xiang died without sons; the state was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince Xiao of Jinan Xiang died without heirs and the state was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，北鄉侯即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Marquis of North Village assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Marquis of North Village assumed the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，丁酉，太尉馮石為太傅，司徒劉熹為太尉，參錄尚書事，前司空李郃為司徒。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingyou, Grand Commandant Feng Shi became Grand Tutor; Minister of Education Liu Xi became Grand Commandant and participated in recording Masters of Writing affairs; former Minister of Works Li He became Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on dingyou day Grand Commandant Feng Shi became Grand Tutor; Minister of Education Liu Xi became Grand Commandant and participated in recording Masters of Writing affairs; former Minister of Works Li He became Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 閻顯忌大將軍耿寶位尊權重，威行前朝，乃風有司奏「寶及其黨與中常侍樊豐、虎賁中郎將謝惲、侍中周廣、野王君王聖、聖女永等更相阿黨，互作威福，皆大不道。

translations.literal: Yan Xian resented that Grand General Geng Bao's position was honored and his power heavy, his authority moving through the former court. He therefore prompted the responsible offices to memorialize that "Bao and his faction, together with Palace Attendant Fan Feng, Colonel of the Rapid Tigers Xie Yun, Palace Attendant Zhou Guang, Prince of Yewang Wang Sheng, and Sheng's daughter Yong and the rest, repeatedly fawned on one another as a clique, each making authority and blessing for himself—all were greatly unfilial."
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xian resented Grand General Geng Bao's honored position and heavy power, his authority still felt from the former court. He therefore prompted the responsible offices to memorialize that "Bao and his faction, together with Palace Attendant Fan Feng, Colonel of the Rapid Tigers Xie Yun, Palace Attendant Zhou Guang, Prince of Yewang Wang Sheng, and Sheng's daughter Yong and the rest, repeatedly formed a clique, each making authority and blessing for himself—all were greatly unfilial."

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，豐、惲、廣皆下獄，死；

translations.literal: " On the day xinmao, Feng, Yun, and Guang were all imprisoned and died;
translations.idiomatic: " On xinmao day Feng, Yun, and Guang were all imprisoned and executed;

sentences.zh: 家屬徙比景。

translations.literal: their families were relocated to Bijing.
translations.idiomatic: their families were relocated to Bijing.

sentences.zh: 貶寶及弟子林慮侯承皆為亭侯，遣就國；

translations.literal: Bao and his nephew Marquis of Linlu Cheng were both demoted to marquises of ting and sent to their states;
translations.idiomatic: Bao and his nephew Marquis of Linlu Cheng were both demoted to ting marquises and sent to their states;

sentences.zh: 寶於道自殺。

translations.literal: Bao killed himself on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Bao killed himself on the road.

sentences.zh: 王聖母子徙雁門。

translations.literal: Wang Sheng and his mother were relocated to Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sheng and his mother were relocated to Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 於是以閻景為衛尉，耀為城門校尉，晏為執金吾，兄弟並處權要，威福自由。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yan Jing was made Commandant of the Guards, Yao made Colonel of the City Gates, and Yan made Bearer of the Gilded Mace; the brothers all held power posts, authority and blessing at their own disposal.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yan Jing was made Commandant of the Guards, Yao Colonel of the City Gates, and Yan Bearer of the Gilded Mace; the brothers all held power posts, authority and blessing at their own disposal.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬孝安皇帝於恭陵，廟曰恭宗。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Emperor Xiaoan was buried at Gong tomb; his temple name was Gongzong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Emperor An was buried at Gong tomb; his temple name was Gongzong.

sentences.zh: 六月，乙巳，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yisi, the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi day, the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，西域長史班勇發敦煌、張掖、酒泉六千騎及鄯善、疏勒、車師前部兵擊後部王軍就，大破之，獲首虜八千餘人，生得軍就及匈奴持節使者，將至索班沒處斬之，傳首京師。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Chief Clerk of the Western Regions Ban Yong dispatched six thousand cavalry from Dunhuang, Zhangye, and Jiuquan, together with troops of Shanshan, Shule, and the Former Department of Cheshi, to strike the Later King Junjiu and greatly defeated him, capturing more than eight thousand heads and prisoners alive. Junjiu and the Xiongnu envoy bearing credentials were taken alive, brought to the place where Suo Ban perished and beheaded, and the head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Western Regions Chief Clerk Ban Yong dispatched six thousand cavalry from Dunhuang, Zhangye, and Jiuquan, together with troops of Shanshan, Shule, and the Former Department of Cheshi, to strike the Later King Junjiu and routed him, taking more than eight thousand heads and captives. Junjiu and the Xiongnu envoy bearing credentials were captured alive, brought to the place where Suo Ban had died and beheaded, and the head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丙午，越巂山崩。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingwu, a mountain in Yuexi collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on bingwu day, a mountain in Yuexi collapsed.

sentences.zh: 北鄉侯病篤，中常侍孫程謂濟陰王謁者長興渠曰：「王以嫡統，本無失德。

translations.literal: The Marquis of North Village's illness was grave. Palace Attendant Sun Cheng said to the Prince of Jibei's Chief of Ushers Xing Qu, "The prince, by legitimate succession, originally had no lost virtue."
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of North Village's illness was grave. Palace Attendant Sun Cheng said to the Prince of Jibei's Chief of Ushers Xing Qu, "The prince, as legitimate heir, originally had no lost virtue."

sentences.zh: 先帝用讒，遂至廢黜。

translations.literal: "The former emperor used slander, and it reached deposal and dismissal."
translations.idiomatic: "The former emperor listened to slander and deposed him."

sentences.zh: 若北鄉侯不起，相與共斷江京、閻顯，事無不成者。

translations.literal: "If the Marquis of North Village does not recover, let us together cut down Jiang Jing and Yan Xian—nothing will fail to succeed."
translations.idiomatic: "If the Marquis of North Village does not recover, let us together cut down Jiang Jing and Yan Xian—nothing will fail."

sentences.zh: 」渠然之。

translations.literal: " Qu assented.
translations.idiomatic: " Qu agreed.

sentences.zh: 又中黃門南陽王康，先為太子府史，及長樂太官丞京兆王國等並附同於程。

translations.literal: Also Central Yellow Gate Wang Kang of Nanyang, who had earlier been a clerk in the crown prince's household, and Chief Steward of Everlasting Joy Wang Guo of Jingzhao and the rest all attached themselves to Cheng in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Also Central Yellow Gate Wang Kang of Nanyang, who had earlier been a clerk in the crown prince's household, and Chief Steward of Everlasting Joy Wang Guo of Jingzhao and the rest all joined Cheng's cause.

sentences.zh: 江京謂閻顯曰：「北鄉侯病不解，國嗣宜以時定，何不早徵諸王子，簡所置乎！

translations.literal: Jiang Jing said to Yan Xian, "The Marquis of North Village's illness does not ease; the state heir ought to be fixed in season—why not early summon the various princes and select whom to install!"
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Jing said to Yan Xian, "The Marquis of North Village's illness does not ease; the succession ought to be settled in time—why not early summon the various princes and choose whom to install!"

sentences.zh: 」顯以為然。

translations.literal: " Xian thought it so.
translations.idiomatic: " Xian agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，北鄉侯薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Marquis of North Village died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Marquis of North Village died.

sentences.zh: 顯白太后，秘不發喪，而更徵諸王子，閉宮門，屯兵自守。

translations.literal: Xian reported to the empress dowager, kept the death secret and did not proclaim mourning, and instead again summoned the various princes, closed the palace gates, and garrisoned troops to guard himself.
translations.idiomatic: Xian reported to the empress dowager, kept the death secret and did not proclaim mourning, and instead again summoned the various princes, closed the palace gates, and garrisoned troops to guard himself.

sentences.zh: 十一月，乙卯，孫程、王康、王國與中黃門黃龍、彭愷、孟叔、李建、王成、張賢、史泛、馬國、王道、李元、楊佗、陳予、趙封、李剛、魏猛、苗光等聚謀於西鐘下，皆截單衣為誓。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yimao, Sun Cheng, Wang Kang, Wang Guo, together with Central Yellow Gates Huang Long, Peng Kai, Meng Shu, Li Jian, Wang Cheng, Zhang Xian, Shi Fan, Ma Guo, Wang Dao, Li Yuan, Yang Tuo, Chen Yu, Zhao Feng, Li Gang, Wei Meng, Miao Guang, and the rest gathered to plot beneath the Western Bell. All cut their unlined garments as oath.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao day, Sun Cheng, Wang Kang, Wang Guo, together with Central Yellow Gates Huang Long, Peng Kai, Meng Shu, Li Jian, Wang Cheng, Zhang Xian, Shi Fan, Ma Guo, Wang Dao, Li Yuan, Yang Tuo, Chen Yu, Zhao Feng, Li Gang, Wei Meng, Miao Guang, and the rest gathered to plot beneath the Western Bell. All cut their unlined garments as oath.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，京師及郡國十六地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the capital and sixteen commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the capital and sixteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是夜，程等共會崇德殿上，因入章臺門。

translations.literal: That night Cheng and the rest jointly met atop Chongde Hall and thereupon entered Zhangtai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That night Cheng and the rest met atop Chongde Hall and entered Zhangtai Gate.

sentences.zh: 時江京、劉發及李閏、陳達等俱坐省門下，程與王康共就斬京、安、達。

translations.literal: At the time Jiang Jing, Liu Fa, and Li Run and Chen Da and the rest were all seated beneath the Secretariat gate. Cheng and Wang Kang together went and beheaded Jing, An, and Da.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jiang Jing, Liu Fa, and Li Run and Chen Da and the rest were all seated beneath the Secretariat gate. Cheng and Wang Kang went together and beheaded Jing, An, and Da.

sentences.zh: 以李閏權勢積為省內所服，欲引為主，因舉刃脅閏曰：「今當立濟陰王，無得搖動！

translations.literal: Because Li Run's accumulated authority and power made him one whom those within the Secretariat submitted to, they wished to draw him as leader and thereupon raised blades to coerce Run, saying, "Now we must install the Prince of Jibei—none may stir!"
translations.idiomatic: Because Li Run's accumulated authority made him one whom those within the Secretariat obeyed, they wished to make him their leader and raised blades to coerce him, saying, "Now we must install the Prince of Jibei—none may stir!"

sentences.zh: 」閏曰：「諾。

translations.literal: " Run said, "Yes."
translations.idiomatic: " Run said, "Yes."

sentences.zh: 」於是扶閏起，俱於西鐘下迎濟陰王即皇帝位，時年十一。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they helped Run rise, and all together beneath the Western Bell welcomed the Prince of Jibei to assume the imperial throne. His age was then eleven.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they helped Run rise, and all together beneath the Western Bell welcomed the Prince of Jibei to the throne. He was then eleven years old.

sentences.zh: 召尚書令、僕射以下從輦幸南宮，程等留守省門，遮扞內外。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing Director, Vice Director, and those below were summoned to follow the carriage in visiting the Southern Palace. Cheng and the rest remained to guard the Secretariat gate, blocking and defending within and without.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Masters of Writing, Vice Director, and those below were summoned to follow the carriage to the Southern Palace. Cheng and the rest remained to guard the Secretariat gate, blocking access within and without.

sentences.zh: 帝登雲台，召公卿、百僚，使虎賁、羽林士屯南、北宮諸門。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended Cloud Terrace, summoned the ducal ministers and the hundred officials, and ordered Rapid Tiger and Forest guards to garrison the various gates of the Southern and Northern Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended Cloud Terrace, summoned the ducal ministers and the hundred officials, and ordered Rapid Tiger and Forest guards to garrison the gates of the Southern and Northern Palaces.

sentences.zh: 閻顯時在禁中，憂迫不知所為，小黃門樊登勸顯以太后詔召越騎校尉馮詩、虎賁中郎將閻崇將兵屯平朔門以御程等。

translations.literal: Yan Xian was then within the Forbidden Quarter, distressed and pressed, not knowing what to do. Junior Yellow Gate Fan Deng urged Xian, by the empress dowager's edict, to summon Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Feng Shi and Colonel of the Rapid Tigers Yan Chong to lead troops and garrison Ping Gate to resist Cheng and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xian was then within the inner palace, distressed and at a loss. Junior Yellow Gate Fan Deng urged him, by the empress dowager's edict, to summon Colonel of the Rapid Cavalry Feng Shi and Colonel of the Rapid Tigers Yan Chong to lead troops and garrison Ping Gate to resist Cheng and the rest.

sentences.zh: 顯誘詩入省，謂曰：「濟陰王立，非皇太后意，璽綬在此。

translations.literal: Xian enticed Shi to enter the Secretariat and said to him, "The Prince of Jibei's installation is not the empress dowager's intent. The seal and cord are here."
translations.idiomatic: Xian lured Shi into the Secretariat and said to him, "The Prince of Jibei's installation is not the empress dowager's intent. The seal and cord are here."

sentences.zh: 苟盡力效功，封侯可得。

translations.literal: "If you exhaust your strength in rendering achievement, enfeoffment as marquis can be obtained."
translations.idiomatic: "If you exhaust your strength in service, you can be enfeoffed as marquis."

sentences.zh: 」太后使授之印曰：「能得濟陰王者，封萬戶侯；

translations.literal: " The empress dowager sent someone to grant him a seal, saying, "Whoever can obtain the Prince of Jibei shall be enfeoffed as marquis of ten thousand households;"
translations.idiomatic: " The empress dowager sent someone to grant him a seal, saying, "Whoever can obtain the Prince of Jibei shall be enfeoffed as marquis of ten thousand households;"

sentences.zh: 得李閏者，五千戶侯。

translations.literal: "whoever can obtain Li Run shall be enfeoffed as marquis of five thousand households."
translations.idiomatic: "whoever can obtain Li Run shall be enfeoffed as marquis of five thousand households."

sentences.zh: 」詩等皆許諾，辭以「卒被召，所將眾少。

translations.literal: " Shi and the rest all promised, excusing themselves that "the soldiers were suddenly summoned; the masses I lead are few."
translations.idiomatic: " Shi and the rest all promised, excusing themselves that "the soldiers were suddenly summoned; the men I lead are few."

sentences.zh: 」顯使與登迎吏士於左掖門外，詩因格殺登，歸營屯守。

translations.literal: " Xian sent him together with Deng to welcome officials and soldiers outside the Left Flank Gate. Shi thereupon struck and killed Deng, returned to camp, and garrisoned in defense.
translations.idiomatic: " Xian sent him with Deng to welcome officials and soldiers outside the Left Flank Gate. Shi thereupon struck and killed Deng, returned to camp, and garrisoned in defense.

sentences.zh: 顯弟衛尉景遽從省中還外府，收兵至盛德門。

translations.literal: Xian's younger brother Commandant of the Guards Jing hastily returned from the Secretariat to the outer offices, gathered troops, and reached Shengde Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Xian's younger brother Commandant of the Guards Jing hastily returned from the Secretariat to the outer offices, gathered troops, and reached Shengde Gate.

sentences.zh: 孫程傳召諸尚書使收景。

translations.literal: Sun Cheng transmitted summons to the various Masters of Writing to have Jing arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Cheng transmitted summons to the various Masters of Writing to have Jing arrested.

sentences.zh: 尚書郭鎮時臥病，聞之，即率直宿羽林出南止車門，逢景從吏士拔白刃呼曰：「無干兵！

translations.literal: Master of Writing Guo Zhen was then ill abed. Hearing of it, he immediately led the on-duty Forest guards out through the Southern Gate Where Chariots Stop, met Jing's following officials and soldiers drawing bright blades, and shouted, "None interfere with the troops!"
translations.idiomatic: Master of Writing Guo Zhen was then ill in bed. Hearing of it, he immediately led the on-duty Forest guards out through the Southern Gate Where Chariots Stop, met Jing's following officials and soldiers drawing bright blades, and shouted, "None interfere with the troops!"

sentences.zh: 」鎮即下車持節詔之，景曰：「何等詔！

translations.literal: " Zhen immediately descended the carriage, held credentials, and proclaimed to him. Jing said, "What sort of proclamation!"
translations.idiomatic: " Zhen immediately descended the carriage, held credentials, and proclaimed to him. Jing said, "What sort of proclamation!"

sentences.zh: 」因斫鎮，不中。

translations.literal: " He thereupon hacked at Zhen and missed.
translations.idiomatic: " He hacked at Zhen and missed.

sentences.zh: 鎮引劍擊景墮車，左右以戟叉其胸，遂禽之，送廷尉獄，即夜死。

translations.literal: Zhen drew his sword, struck Jing, and knocked him from the carriage. Those at left and right used halberds to pin his chest, then captured him and sent him to the Minister of Justice's prison. That very night he died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen drew his sword, struck Jing, and knocked him from the carriage. His attendants pinned his chest with halberds, captured him, and sent him to the Minister of Justice's prison. That very night he died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣使者入省，奪得璽綬，帝乃幸嘉德殿，遣侍御史持節收閻顯及其弟城門校尉耀、執金吾晏，並下獄，誅；

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, envoys were sent into the Secretariat; the seal and cord were seized. The emperor thereupon visited Jiade Hall, sent Palace Attendants bearing credentials to arrest Yan Xian and his younger brothers Colonel of the City Gates Yao and Bearer of the Gilded Mace Yan, and all were imprisoned and executed;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys were sent into the Secretariat and the seal and cord were seized. translations.idiomatic: Xu investigated him, but the cases were repeatedly shelved without response.

sentences.zh: 詡不勝其憤，乃自系廷尉，奏言曰：「昔孝安皇帝任用樊豐，交亂嫡統，幾亡社稷。

translations.literal: Xu, unable to bear his anger, bound himself and presented himself to the Commandant of Justice, memorializing: "In the past Emperor Xiao'an employed Fan Feng, who disturbed the legitimate succession and nearly destroyed the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bear his anger, Xu bound himself and presented himself to the Commandant of Justice, memorializing: "In the past Emperor Xiao'an employed Fan Feng, who disturbed the legitimate succession and nearly destroyed the state."

sentences.zh: 今者張防復弄威柄，國家之禍將重至矣。

translations.literal: Now Zhang Fang again plays with the handle of power; the state's calamity is about to come again.
translations.idiomatic: Now Zhang Fang again wields power; the state's calamity is about to return."

sentences.zh: 臣不忍與防同朝，謹自系以聞，無令臣襲楊震之跡！

translations.literal: Your servant cannot bear to be in court with Fang and respectfully binds himself to report this—do not let your servant follow in Yang Zhen's tracks!"
translations.idiomatic: I cannot bear to serve in court with Fang and respectfully bind myself to report this—do not let me follow Yang Zhen's fate!"

sentences.zh: 」書奏，防流涕訴帝，詡坐論輸左校；

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, Fang wept and pleaded to the emperor; Xu was sentenced and sent to the Left Corps;
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, Fang wept and pleaded to the emperor. Xu was sentenced and sent to the Left Corps;

sentences.zh: 防必欲害之，二日之中，傳考四獄。

translations.literal: Fang was determined to destroy him; within two days he was interrogated under torture in four prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was determined to destroy him. Within two days he was tortured in four prisons.

sentences.zh: 獄吏勸詡自引，詡曰：「寧伏歐刀以示遠近！

translations.literal: The prison clerks urged Xu to take his own life; Xu said, "I would rather submit to the executioner's blade to show those far and near!
translations.idiomatic: The prison clerks urged Xu to kill himself. Xu said, "I would rather submit to the executioner's blade to show those far and near!"

sentences.zh: 喑嗚自殺，是非孰辨邪！

translations.literal: to die by secret suicide—who then could distinguish right from wrong!"
translations.idiomatic: to die by secret suicide—who then could tell right from wrong?"

sentences.zh: 」浮陽侯孫程、祝阿侯張賢相率乞見，程曰：「陛下始與臥等造事之時，常疾奸臣，知其傾國。

translations.literal: " Marquis of Fuyang Sun Cheng and Marquis of Zhu'e Zhang Xian together begged audience. Cheng said, "When Your Majesty first undertook the enterprise with us who lay in wait, you often hated treacherous ministers and knew they overturn states.
translations.idiomatic: " Marquis of Fuyang Sun Cheng and Marquis of Zhu'e Zhang Xian together begged audience. Cheng said, "When Your Majesty first undertook the enterprise with us, you hated treacherous ministers and knew they overturn states."

sentences.zh: 今者即位而復自為，何以非先帝乎！

translations.literal: Now, having taken the throne, you again act on your own—how does this differ from criticizing the former emperor!"
translations.idiomatic: Now, having taken the throne, you again act on your own—how is this unlike faulting the former emperor!"

sentences.zh: 司隸校尉虞詡為陛下盡忠，而更被拘繫；

translations.literal: Director of Retainers Yu Xu has exhausted loyalty for Your Majesty, yet is further imprisoned;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Retainers Yu Xu has been utterly loyal to Your Majesty, yet is imprisoned;"

sentences.zh: 常侍張防臧罪明正，反構忠良。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Zhang Fang's guilt is clear, yet he frames the loyal and good.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Zhang Fang's guilt is clear, yet he frames the loyal."

sentences.zh: 今客星守羽林，其占宮中有奸臣；

translations.literal: Now a guest star guards Yulin; its omen is that within the palace there is a treacherous minister;
translations.idiomatic: Now a guest star guards Yulin; its omen is a treacherous minister within the palace;"

sentences.zh: 宜急收防送獄，以塞天變。

translations.literal: Your Majesty ought urgently to seize Fang and send him to prison to stem Heaven's warning."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty ought urgently to seize Fang and imprison him to stem Heaven's warning."

sentences.zh: 」時防立在帝后，程叱防曰：「奸臣張防，何不下殿！

translations.literal: " At this time Fang stood behind the emperor; Cheng shouted at Fang: "Treacherous minister Zhang Fang—why do you not leave the hall!"
translations.idiomatic: " At this time Fang stood behind the emperor. Cheng shouted at Fang: "Treacherous minister Zhang Fang—why do you not leave the hall!"

sentences.zh: 」防不得已，趨就東箱。

translations.literal: " Fang had no choice and hurried to the eastern side chamber.
translations.idiomatic: " Fang had no choice and hurried to the eastern side chamber.

sentences.zh: 程曰：「陛下急收防，無令從阿母求請！

translations.literal: Cheng said, "Your Majesty, urgently seize Fang—do not let him seek favor through the foster mother!"
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said, "Your Majesty, urgently seize Fang—do not let him seek favor through the foster mother!"

sentences.zh: 」帝問諸尚書，尚書賈朗素與防善，證詡之罪；

translations.literal: " The emperor asked the Masters of Writing; Master of Writing Jia Lang, who had long been friendly with Fang, attested to Xu's guilt;
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked the Masters of Writing. Master of Writing Jia Lang, who had long been friendly with Fang, attested to Xu's guilt;

sentences.zh: 帝疑焉，謂程曰：「且出，吾方思之！

translations.literal: the emperor was doubtful and said to Cheng, "Withdraw for now—I am still considering it!"
translations.idiomatic: the emperor was doubtful and said to Cheng, "Withdraw for now—I am still considering it!"

sentences.zh: 」於是詡子顗與門生百餘人，舉幡候中常侍高梵車，叩頭流血，訴言枉狀。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Xu's son Yan and more than a hundred disciples raised banners and waited for Palace Attendant Gao Fan's carriage, knocking their heads until they bled and pleading that the case was wrongful.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Xu's son Yan and more than a hundred disciples raised banners and waited for Palace Attendant Gao Fan's carriage, knocking their heads until they bled and pleading wrongful imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 梵入言之，防坐徙邊，賈朗等六人或死或黜；

translations.literal: Fan entered and reported; Fang was sentenced to banishment, and Jia Lang and six others were either executed or dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: Fan entered and reported. Fang was banished, and Jia Lang and six others were either executed or dismissed;

sentences.zh: 即日赦出詡。

translations.literal: that same day Xu was pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: that same day Xu was pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 程復上書陳詡有大功，語甚切激。

translations.literal: Cheng again submitted a memorial stating Xu had great merit; his words were very cutting and impassioned.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng again memorialized that Xu had great merit; his words were very cutting.

sentences.zh: 帝感悟，復徵拜議郎；

translations.literal: The emperor was moved to understanding and again summoned and appointed him Consultation Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved and again summoned him as Consultation Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 數日，遷尚書僕射。

translations.literal: within days he was transferred to Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: within days he was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 詡上疏薦議郎南陽左雄曰：「臣見方今公卿以下，類多拱默，以樹恩為賢，盡節為愚，至相戒曰：『白璧不可為，容容多後福。

translations.literal: Xu submitted a memorial recommending Consultation Gentleman Zuo Xiong of Nanyang: "Your servant sees that among excellencies and ministers down, most are silent with folded hands, taking cultivation of favor as worthy and exhausting integrity as foolish—even warning one another, 'The white jade must not be touched; easy compliance brings later blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Xu memorialized recommending Consultation Gentleman Zuo Xiong of Nanyang: "I see that among excellencies and ministers down, most keep silent, taking cultivation of favor as worthy and exhausting integrity as foolish—even warning one another, 'Do not touch white jade; easy compliance brings later blessing."

sentences.zh: 』伏見議郎左雄，有王臣蹇蹇之節，宜擢在喉舌之官，必有國弼之益。

translations.literal: ' Your servant has observed Consultation Gentleman Zuo Xiong, who has the upright integrity of a king's minister; he ought to be promoted to a throat-and-tongue office and will surely benefit the state as a buttress."
translations.idiomatic: ' I observe Consultation Gentleman Zuo Xiong, who has a king's minister's upright integrity; he ought to be promoted to a speaking office and will surely buttress the state."

sentences.zh: 」由是拜雄尚書。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Xiong was appointed Master of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Xiong was appointed Master of Writing.

sentences.zh: 浮陽侯孫程等懷表上殿爭功，帝怒。

translations.literal: Marquis of Fuyang Sun Cheng and others, bearing memorials, went up to the hall to dispute merit; the emperor was angry.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Fuyang Sun Cheng and others went up to the hall bearing memorials to dispute merit; the emperor was angry.

sentences.zh: 有司劾奏「程等於亂悖逆，王國等皆與程黨，久留京都，益其驕恣。

translations.literal: The responsible officials impeached: "Cheng and others were disorderly and rebellious; Wang Guo and the rest are all Cheng's faction, long remaining in the capital and increasing their arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials impeached: "Cheng and others were disorderly and rebellious; Wang Guo and the rest are all Cheng's faction, long remaining in the capital and growing more arrogant."

sentences.zh: 」帝乃免程等官，悉徙封遠縣。

translations.literal: " The emperor then dismissed Cheng and the rest from office and all transferred their enfeoffments to distant counties.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then dismissed Cheng and the rest from office and transferred all their enfeoffments to distant counties.

sentences.zh: 因遺十九侯就國，敕洛陽令促期發遺。

translations.literal: Thereupon he sent the nineteen marquises to their states and ordered the magistrate of Luoyang to hasten their departure on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent the nineteen marquises to their states and ordered the magistrate of Luoyang to hasten their departure.

sentences.zh: 司徒掾周舉說朱倀曰：「朝廷在西鐘下時，非孫程等豈立！

translations.literal: A clerk of the Minister over the Masses, Zhou Ju, urged Zhu Yi: "When the court was below the west bell, without Sun Cheng and the rest, how could Your Majesty have been established!
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses clerk Zhou Ju urged Zhu Yi: "When the court was below the west bell, without Sun Cheng and the rest how could Your Majesty have been established!"

sentences.zh: 今忘其大德，錄其小過。

translations.literal: Now you forget their great merit and record their small faults.
translations.idiomatic: Now you forget their great merit and record their small faults."

sentences.zh: 如道路夭折，帝有殺功臣之譏。

translations.literal: If they die on the road prematurely, Your Majesty will bear the reproach of killing meritorious servants.
translations.idiomatic: If they die on the road, Your Majesty will bear the reproach of killing meritorious servants."

sentences.zh: 及今未去，宜急表之！

translations.literal: While they have not yet gone, you ought urgently to memorialize!"
translations.idiomatic: While they have not yet gone, you ought urgently to memorialize!"

sentences.zh: 倀曰：「今詔指方怒，吾獨表此，必致罪譴。

translations.literal: Yi said, "The edict's intent is now angry; if I alone memorialize this, I am sure to incur punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "The edict's intent is angry now; if I alone memorialize this I am sure to be punished."

sentences.zh: 」舉曰：「明公年過八十，位為台輔，不於今時竭忠報國，惜身安，欲以何求！

translations.literal: " Ju said, "Your Excellency is past eighty and holds terrace and chariot rank—if not at this time you exhaust loyalty and serve the state, cherishing your person in safety, what do you seek!"
translations.idiomatic: " Ju said, "Your Excellency is past eighty and holds the highest rank—if not now you exhaust loyalty and serve the state, cherishing safety, what do you seek!"

sentences.zh: 祿位雖全，必陷佞邪之機；

translations.literal: Though salary and rank are preserved, you will surely fall into the snare of flattery and wickedness;
translations.idiomatic: Though salary and rank are preserved, you will fall into flattery and wickedness;"

sentences.zh: 諫而獲罪，猶有忠貞之名。

translations.literal: to remonstrate and receive punishment still leaves the name of loyalty and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: to remonstrate and be punished still leaves a name for loyalty."

sentences.zh: 若舉言不足采，請從此辭！

translations.literal: If Your Excellency's words are not worth adopting, I beg to take leave from here!"
translations.idiomatic: If my words are not worth adopting, I beg to take my leave!"

sentences.zh: 」倀乃表諫，帝果從之。

translations.literal: " Yi then memorialized in remonstrance, and the emperor indeed followed it.
translations.idiomatic: " Yi then memorialized in remonstrance, and the emperor followed it.

sentences.zh: 程徙封宜城侯，到國，怨恨恚懟，封還印綬、符策，亡歸京師，往來山中。

translations.literal: Cheng was transferred and enfeoffed as Marquis of Yicheng; reaching his state, resentful and indignant, he sealed and returned seal and ribbon, tally and patent, fled back to the capital, and went to and fro in the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was transferred to Marquis of Yicheng. Reaching his state, resentful and indignant, he returned seal, ribbon, tally, and patent, fled back to the capital, and wandered in the mountains.

sentences.zh: 詔書追求，復故爵土，賜車馬、衣物，遣還國。

translations.literal: An edict pursued him; his former rank and fief were restored, carriage, horses, and clothing were bestowed, and he was sent back to his state.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pursued him, restored his former rank and fief, bestowed carriage, horses, and clothing, and sent him back to his state.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丁亥，司空陶敦免。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dinghai day, Minister of Works Tao Dun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on dinghai day, Minister of Works Tao Dun was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 朔方以西，障塞多壞，鮮卑因此數侵南匈奴；

translations.literal: West of Shuofang, many border barriers were ruined, and the Xianbei therefore several times raided the Southern Xiongnu;
translations.idiomatic: West of Shuofang many border barriers were ruined, and the Xianbei therefore repeatedly raided the Southern Xiongnu;

sentences.zh: 單于憂恐，上書乞修復障塞。

translations.literal: the chanyu was anxious and fearful and submitted a memorial begging repair of the barriers.
translations.idiomatic: the chanyu was anxious and memorialized begging repair of the barriers.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔：「黎陽營兵出屯中山北界；

translations.literal: On gengyin day, an edict: "Troops of the Liyang camp shall go out and garrison the northern border of Zhongshan;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict ordered: "Troops of the Liyang camp shall garrison the northern border of Zhongshan;"

sentences.zh: 令緣邊郡增置步兵，列屯塞下，教習戰射。

translations.literal: order the border commanderies to add foot soldiers, array them in garrison below the passes, and teach battle and archery."
translations.idiomatic: order the border commanderies to add foot soldiers, garrison them below the passes, and teach battle and archery."

sentences.zh: 以廷尉張皓為司空。

translations.literal: Commandant of Justice Zhang Hao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant of Justice Zhang Hao was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 班勇更立車師後部故王子加特奴為王。

translations.literal: Ban Yong again established the former prince of the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi, Jianute, as king.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Yong again established the former prince of the Rear Kingdom of Cheshi, Jianute, as king.

sentences.zh: 勇又使別校誅斬東且彌王，亦更立其種人為王；

translations.literal: Yong also sent a separate colonel to execute the king of Eastern Qumi and again established a man of that tribe as king;
translations.idiomatic: Yong also sent a separate colonel to execute the king of Eastern Qumi and again established a tribesman as king;

sentences.zh: 於是車師六國悉平。

translations.literal: thereupon the six states of Cheshi were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: thereby the six states of Cheshi were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 勇遂發諸國兵擊匈奴，呼銜王亡走，其眾二萬餘人皆降。

translations.literal: Yong then mobilized the armies of the various states to attack the Xiongnu; King Huyan fled, and his masses of more than twenty thousand all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yong then mobilized the armies of the various states against the Xiongnu. King Huyan fled and more than twenty thousand of his followers submitted.

sentences.zh: 生得單于人兄，勇使加特奴手斬之，以結車師、匈奴之隙。

translations.literal: They captured the chanyu's elder brother alive; Yong had Jianute personally behead him to seal the breach between Cheshi and the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: They captured the chanyu's elder brother alive. Yong had Jianute personally behead him to seal the breach between Cheshi and the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 北單于自將萬餘騎入後部，至金且谷；

translations.literal: The Northern Chanyu himself led more than ten thousand horsemen into the Rear Kingdom as far as Jinqie Valley;
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Chanyu himself led more than ten thousand horsemen into the rear kingdom as far as Jinqie Valley;

sentences.zh: 勇使假司馬曹俊救之，單于引去，俊追斬其貴人骨都侯。

translations.literal: Yong sent Acting Major Cao Jun to rescue them; the chanyu withdrew, and Jun pursued and beheaded his noble Guduhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yong sent Acting Major Cao Jun to rescue them. The chanyu withdrew and Jun pursued and killed his noble Guduhou.

sentences.zh: 於是呼衍王遂徙居枯梧河上，是後車師無復虜跡。

translations.literal: Thereupon King Huyan moved to dwell on the Kuwu River, and after this Cheshi had no further traces of barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon King Huyan moved to the Kuwu River, and afterward Cheshi saw no further barbarian presence.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，中郎將張國以南單于兵擊鮮卑其至鞬，破之。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Colonel of the Gentlemen Zhang Guo with the Southern Chanyu's troops attacked the Xianbei Qizhijian and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, Colonel Zhang Guo with the Southern Chanyu's troops attacked the Xianbei Qizhijian and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二月，遼東鮮卑寇遼東玄菟；

translations.literal: In the second month, the Liaodong Xianbei raided Liaodong and Xuantu;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Liaodong Xianbei raided Liaodong and Xuantu;

sentences.zh: 烏桓校尉耿曄發緣邊諸郡兵及烏桓出塞擊之，斬獲甚眾；

translations.literal: Colonel of the Wuhuan Geng Ye mobilized border commandery troops and the Wuhuan beyond the pass to strike them, beheading and capturing a great host;
translations.idiomatic: Colonel of the Wuhuan Geng Ye mobilized border commandery troops and the Wuhuan beyond the pass to strike them, taking many heads and captives;

sentences.zh: 鮮卑三萬人詣遼東降。

translations.literal: thirty thousand Xianbei came to Liaodong to submit.
translations.idiomatic: and thirty thousand Xianbei came to Liaodong to submit.

sentences.zh: 三月，旱。

translations.literal: In the third month, there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month there was drought.

sentences.zh: 初，帝母李氏瘞在洛陽北，帝初不知；

translations.literal: Earlier, the emperor's mother Lady Li was buried in the north of Luoyang, and at first the emperor did not know;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the emperor's mother Lady Li was buried north of Luoyang, and at first the emperor did not know;

sentences.zh: 至是，左右白之，帝乃發哀，親到瘞所，更以禮殯。

translations.literal: at this time those about him informed him; the emperor then expressed mourning, went in person to the burial place, and again interred her with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: at this time those about him informed him. The emperor then expressed mourning, went in person to the burial place, and again interred her with full rites.

sentences.zh: 六月，乙酉，追謚為恭愍皇后，葬於恭陵之北。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, she was posthumously titled Empress Gongmin and buried north of Gong Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiyou day, she was posthumously titled Empress Gongmin and buried north of Gong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 西域城郭諸國皆服於漢，唯焉耆王元孟未降，班勇奏請攻之。

translations.literal: The walled states of the Western Regions all submitted to Han; only King Yuan Meng of Yanqi had not submitted, and Ban Yong memorialized requesting an attack.
translations.idiomatic: The walled states of the Western Regions all submitted to Han; only King Yuan Meng of Yanqi had not submitted, and Ban Yong memorialized requesting an attack.

sentences.zh: 於是遣敦煌太守張朗將河西四郡兵三千人配勇，因發諸國兵四萬餘人分為兩道擊之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Administrator of Dunhuang Zhang Lang was sent to lead three thousand troops of the four Hexi commanderies to join Yong, and troops of the various states totaling more than forty thousand were mobilized and divided into two columns to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Administrator of Dunhuang Zhang Lang was sent to lead three thousand troops of the four Hexi commanderies to join Ban Yong, and troops of the various states totaling more than forty thousand were mobilized and divided into two columns to attack.

sentences.zh: 勇從南道，朗從北道，約期俱至焉耆。

translations.literal: Yong took the southern route, Lang the northern, agreeing to arrive at Yanqi together on a set date.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Yong took the southern route and Zhang Lang the northern, agreeing to arrive at Yanqi together on a set date.

sentences.zh: 而朗先有罪，欲徼功自贖，遂先期至爵離關，遣司馬將兵前戰，獲首虜二千餘人，元孟懼誅，逆遣使乞降。

translations.literal: But Lang had earlier committed a crime and wished to win merit to redeem himself; he therefore arrived ahead of schedule at Jueli Pass, sent his Major with troops to fight in advance, and obtained more than two thousand heads and captives; Yuan Meng feared execution and beforehand sent envoys to beg submission.
translations.idiomatic: But Zhang Lang had earlier committed a crime and wished to win merit to redeem himself. He therefore arrived ahead of schedule at Jueli Pass, sent his Major with troops to fight in advance, and took more than two thousand heads and captives. Yuan Meng feared execution and beforehand sent envoys to beg submission.

sentences.zh: 張朗徑入焉耆，受降而還。

translations.literal: Zhang Lang went straight into Yanqi, accepted the surrender, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lang went straight into Yanqi, accepted the surrender, and returned.

sentences.zh: 朗得免誅，勇以後期徵，下獄，免。

translations.literal: Lang was spared execution; Yong was summoned for being late, imprisoned, and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lang was spared execution. Ban Yong was summoned for being late, imprisoned, and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，甲戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the first day jiaxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太尉朱寵、司徒朱倀免。

translations.literal: On renwu, Grand Commandant Zhu Chong and Minister over the Masses Zhu Yi were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Grand Commandant Zhu Chong and Minister over the Masses Zhu Yi were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以太常劉光為太尉、錄尚書事，光祿勳汝南許敬為司徒。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Grand Master of Ceremonies Liu Guang was made Grand Commandant and Recorder of Matters Relating to the Masters of Writing; Household Minister Xu Jing of Runan was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Grand Master of Ceremonies Liu Guang was made Grand Commandant and Recorder of Matters Relating to the Masters of Writing, and Household Minister Xu Jing of Runan was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 光，矩之弟也。

translations.literal: Guang was the younger brother of Ju.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guang was the younger brother of Liu Ju.

sentences.zh: 敬仕於和、安之間，當竇、鄧、閻氏之盛，無所屈撓；

translations.literal: Jing served between the He and An reigns, when the Dou, Deng, and Yan clans were at their height, yet he bent to none;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jing served between the He and An reigns, when the Dou, Deng, and Yan clans were at their height, yet he bent to none;

sentences.zh: 三家既敗，士大夫多染污者，獨無謗言及於敬，當世以此貴之。

translations.literal: after the three houses had fallen many scholar-officials were stained, yet no slander reached Jing, and the age for this held him in honor.
translations.idiomatic: after the three houses had fallen many scholar-officials were stained, yet no slander reached Xu Jing, and the age for this held him in honor.

sentences.zh: 初，南陽樊英，少有學行，名著海內，陷於壺山之陽，州郡前後禮請，不應；

translations.literal: Earlier, Fan Ying of Nanyang from youth had learning and conduct, his fame known within the seas; he dwelt on the southern slope of Mount Hu, and though provinces and commanderies repeatedly invited him with ceremony, he did not respond;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Fan Ying of Nanyang from youth had learning and conduct and his fame was known within the seas. He dwelt on the southern slope of Mount Hu, and though provinces and commanderies repeatedly invited him with ceremony, he did not respond;

sentences.zh: 公卿舉賢良、方正、有道，皆不行；

translations.literal: the dukes and ministers recommended him as Worthy, Upright, and Possessed of the Way, yet he would not go;
translations.idiomatic: the dukes and ministers recommended him as Worthy, Upright, and Possessed of the Way, yet he would not go;

sentences.zh: 安帝賜策書徵之，不赴。

translations.literal: Emperor An bestowed a written summons and called him, but he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An bestowed a written summons and called him, but he did not come.

sentences.zh: 是歲，帝復以策書、玄纁，備禮徵英，英固辭疾篤。

translations.literal: That year the emperor again with written summons and black-and-red silks, with full ceremony summoned Ying; Ying firmly pleaded grave illness.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor again summoned Fan Ying with written summons and black-and-red silks and full ceremony, but Ying firmly pleaded grave illness.

sentences.zh: 詔切責郡縣，駕載上道。

translations.literal: An edict sharply reproved the commanderies and counties, and he was carried in a carriage onto the road.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sharply reproved the commanderies and counties, and he was carried in a carriage onto the road.

sentences.zh: 英不得已，到京，稱疾不肯起；

translations.literal: Ying had no choice but to arrive at the capital, claimed illness and would not rise;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ying had no choice but to arrive at the capital, claimed illness, and would not rise;

sentences.zh: 強輿入殿，猶不能屈。

translations.literal: he was forcibly carried into the hall, yet still could not be bent.
translations.idiomatic: he was forcibly carried into the hall, yet still could not be bent.

sentences.zh: 帝使出就太醫養疾，月致羊酒。

translations.literal: The emperor had him go out to the Imperial Physician to nurse his illness, and each month sent mutton and wine.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had him go out to the Imperial Physician to nurse his illness, and each month sent mutton and wine.

sentences.zh: 其後帝乃為英設壇，令公車令導，尚書奉引，賜幾、杖，待以師傅之禮，延問得失，拜五官中郎將。

translations.literal: Afterward the emperor then set up an altar for Ying, ordered the Director of the Imperial Carriages to lead, the Masters of Writing to attend and conduct, bestowed a armrest and staff, treated him with the rites due a tutor, extended inquiry into gains and losses, and appointed him Colonel of the Five Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the emperor set up an altar for Fan Ying, ordered the Director of the Imperial Carriages to lead and the Masters of Writing to attend and conduct, bestowed an armrest and staff, treated him with the rites due a tutor, extended inquiry into gains and losses, and appointed him Colonel of the Five Offices.

sentences.zh: 數月，英稱疾篤；

translations.literal: After several months Ying claimed grave illness;
translations.idiomatic: After several months Fan Ying claimed grave illness;

sentences.zh: 詔以為光祿大夫，賜告歸，令在所送谷，以歲時致牛酒。

translations.literal: an edict made him Household Minister, granted leave to return home, ordered the locality to send grain, and at the seasons to deliver oxen and wine.
translations.idiomatic: an edict made him Household Minister, granted leave to return home, ordered the locality to send grain, and at the seasons to deliver oxen and wine.

sentences.zh: 英辭位不受，有詔譬旨，勿聽。

translations.literal: Ying declined the rank and would not accept; an edict explained the intent and forbade refusal.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ying declined the rank and would not accept. An edict explained the intent and forbade refusal.

sentences.zh: 英初被詔命，眾皆以為必不降志。

translations.literal: When Ying was first under the imperial summons, the multitude all thought he would surely not lower his resolve.
translations.idiomatic: When Fan Ying was first under the imperial summons, the multitude all thought he would surely not lower his resolve.

sentences.zh: 南郡王逸素與英善，因與其書，多引古譬諭，勸使就聘。

translations.literal: Wang Yi of Nan commandery had long been friendly with Ying and therefore wrote him a letter with many ancient analogies and persuasions, urging him to accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi of Nan commandery had long been friendly with Fan Ying and therefore wrote him a letter with many ancient analogies and persuasions, urging him to accept the appointment.

sentences.zh: 英順逸議而至；

translations.literal: Ying followed Yi's counsel and came;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Ying followed Wang Yi's counsel and came;

sentences.zh: 及後應對無奇謀深策，談者以為失望。

translations.literal: but afterward in his responses there were no extraordinary plans or deep policies, and those who discussed it felt disappointment.
translations.idiomatic: but afterward in his responses there were no extraordinary plans or deep policies, and those who discussed it felt disappointment.

sentences.zh: 河南張楷與英俱徵，謂英曰：「天下有二道，出與處也。

translations.literal: Zhang Kai of Henan was summoned together with Ying and said to Ying: "All under heaven has two paths—going forth and staying put.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Kai of Henan was summoned together with Fan Ying and said to him, "All under heaven has two paths—going forth and staying put.

sentences.zh: 吾前以子之出，能輔是君也，濟斯民也。

translations.literal: I formerly thought that in your going forth you could assist this ruler and succor these people.
translations.idiomatic: I formerly thought that in your going forth you could assist this ruler and succor these people.

sentences.zh: 而子始以不訾之身，怒萬乘之主，及其享受爵祿，又不聞匡救之術，進退無所據矣。

translations.literal: Yet you first with an unblemished person angered a ruler of ten thousand chariots, and once you enjoyed rank and salary you were not heard to have methods of correction and rescue—going forth and staying put have no footing left."
translations.idiomatic: Yet you first with an unblemished person angered a ruler of ten thousand chariots, and once you enjoyed rank and salary you were not heard to have methods of correction and rescue—going forth and staying put have no footing left."

sentences.zh: 臣光曰：古之君子，邦有道則仕，邦無道則隱。

translations.literal: Subject Guang said: The gentleman of old, when the state had the Way then served; when the state lacked the Way then hid.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang remarks: The gentleman of old, when the state had the Way then served; when the state lacked the Way then hid.

sentences.zh: 隱非君子之所欲也。

translations.literal: Hiding was not what the gentleman desired.
translations.idiomatic: Hiding was not what the gentleman desired.

sentences.zh: 人莫己知而道不得行，群邪共處而害將及身，故深藏以避之。

translations.literal: No one knew him yet the Way could not be practiced; the wicked dwelt together and harm was about to reach his person—therefore he hid deep to avoid it.
translations.idiomatic: No one knew him yet the Way could not be practiced; the wicked dwelt together and harm was about to reach his person—therefore he hid deep to avoid it.

sentences.zh: 王者舉逸民，揚仄陋，固為其有益於國家，非以徇世俗之耳目也。

translations.literal: When kings raised reclusive subjects and exalted the obscure and lowly, it was truly because they benefited the state, not to please the eyes and ears of the vulgar world.
translations.idiomatic: When kings raised reclusive subjects and exalted the obscure and lowly, it was truly because they benefited the state, not to please the eyes and ears of the vulgar world.

sentences.zh: 是故有道德足以尊主，智能足以庇民，被褐懷玉，深藏不市，則王者當盡禮以致之，屈體以下之，虛心以訪之，克己以從之，然後能利澤施於四表，功烈格於上下。

translations.literal: Therefore if moral power was enough to honor the ruler and wisdom enough to shelter the people, wearing coarse cloth yet cherishing jade, hiding deep and not offering himself for sale—then the king ought with full rites to bring him, bow the body to descend to him, empty the mind to consult him, restrain the self to follow him—only then could benefit and grace spread to the four quarters and merit and glory reach above and below.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore if moral power was enough to honor the ruler and wisdom enough to shelter the people, wearing coarse cloth yet cherishing jade, hiding deep and not offering himself for sale—then the king ought with full rites to bring him, bow the body to descend to him, empty the mind to consult him, and restrain the self to follow him—only then could benefit and grace spread to the four quarters and merit and glory reach above and below.

sentences.zh: 蓋取其道不取其人，務其實不務其名也。

translations.literal: This was taking his Way, not taking the man; seeking the substance, not seeking the name.
translations.idiomatic: This was taking his Way, not taking the man; seeking the substance, not seeking the name.

sentences.zh: 其或禮備而不至，意勤而不起，則姑內自循省而不敢強致其人，曰：豈吾德之薄而不足慕乎？

translations.literal: If rites were complete yet he did not come, intent earnest yet he did not rise—then for the moment he turned inward to examine himself and did not dare force the man, saying: Is my virtue thin and not worth esteeming?
translations.idiomatic: If rites were complete yet he did not come, intent earnest yet he did not rise—then for the moment he turned inward to examine himself and did not dare force the man, saying, Is my virtue thin and not worth esteeming?

sentences.zh: 政之亂而不可輔乎？

translations.literal: Is government chaotic and not to be assisted?
translations.idiomatic: Is government chaotic and not to be assisted?

sentences.zh: 群小在朝而不敢進乎？

translations.literal: Are petty men in court and one dares not advance?
translations.idiomatic: Are petty men in court and one dares not advance?

sentences.zh: 誠心不至而憂其言之不用乎？

translations.literal: Is sincere heart not arrived and one fears his words will not be used?
translations.idiomatic: Is sincere heart not arrived and one fears his words will not be used?

sentences.zh: 何賢者之不我從也？

translations.literal: Why do the worthy not follow me?
translations.idiomatic: Why do the worthy not follow me?

sentences.zh: 苟其德已厚矣，政已治矣，群小遠矣，誠心至矣，彼將扣閽以自售，又安有勤求而不至者哉！

translations.literal: If his virtue were already thick, government already ordered, petty men far off, sincere heart arrived—then they would knock at the gate to offer themselves; how could there be earnest seeking yet failure to come!
translations.idiomatic: If his virtue were already thick, government already ordered, petty men far off, and sincere heart arrived—then they would knock at the gate to offer themselves. How could there be earnest seeking yet failure to come!

sentences.zh: 荀子曰：「耀蟬者，務在明其火，振其木而已；

translations.literal: Xunzi said: "One who gathers cicadas with fire must make the fire bright and shake the tree—that is all;"
translations.idiomatic: Xunzi said, "One who gathers cicadas with fire must make the fire bright and shake the tree—that is all;"

sentences.zh: 火不明，雖振其木，無益也。

translations.literal: "if the fire is not bright, though one shakes the tree, it is of no use.
translations.idiomatic: "if the fire is not bright, though one shakes the tree, it is of no use.

sentences.zh: 今人主有能明其德，則天下歸之，若蟬之歸明火也。

translations.literal: If today's ruler can make his virtue bright, then all under heaven will come to him, as cicadas come to bright fire."
translations.idiomatic: If today's ruler can make his virtue bright, then all under heaven will come to him, as cicadas come to bright fire."

sentences.zh: 」或者人主恥不能致，乃至誘之以高位，脅之以嚴刑。

translations.literal: " Some rulers, shamed that they cannot bring men, even entice them with high rank and threaten them with severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: " Some rulers, shamed that they cannot bring men, even entice them with high rank and threaten them with severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 使彼誠君子邪，則位非所貪，刑非所畏，終不可得而致也；

translations.literal: If they were truly gentlemen, then rank is not what they covet and punishment not what they fear—in the end they cannot be brought;
translations.idiomatic: If they were truly gentlemen, then rank is not what they covet and punishment not what they fear—in the end they cannot be brought;

sentences.zh: 可致者，皆貪位畏刑之人也，烏足貴哉！

translations.literal: those who can be brought are all men who covet rank and fear punishment—how are they worth honoring!
translations.idiomatic: those who can be brought are all men who covet rank and fear punishment—how are they worth honoring!

sentences.zh: 若乃孝弟著於家庭，行誼隆於鄉曲，利不苟取，仕不苟進，潔己安分，優遊卒歲，雖不足以尊主庇民，是亦清修之吉士也。

translations.literal: As for those whose filial piety and brotherliness shine in the family and whose conduct and righteousness rise in the village lanes, who do not grasp profit at random or advance in office at random, who keep themselves pure and rest in their lot, passing the year at ease—though not enough to honor the ruler and shelter the people, these too are auspicious gentlemen of pure cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: As for those whose filial piety and brotherliness shine in the family and whose conduct and righteousness rise in the village lanes, who do not grasp profit at random or advance in office at random, who keep themselves pure and rest in their lot, passing the year at ease—though not enough to honor the ruler and shelter the people, these too are auspicious gentlemen of pure cultivation.

sentences.zh: 王者當褒優安養，俾遂其志。

translations.literal: Kings ought to praise, favor, settle, and nurture them, enabling them to fulfill their intent.
translations.idiomatic: Kings ought to praise, favor, settle, and nurture them, enabling them to fulfill their intent.

sentences.zh: 若孝昭之待韓福，光武之遇周黨，以勵廉恥，美風俗，斯亦可矣，固不當如范升之詆毀，又不可如張楷之責望也。

translations.literal: Like Emperor Xiaozhao's treatment of Han Fu or Emperor Guangwu's meeting with Zhou Dang—to encourage integrity and shame and beautify custom—this too is fitting; one certainly should not, like Fan Sheng, slander them, nor, like Zhang Kai, press demands upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Like Emperor Xiaozhao's treatment of Han Fu or Emperor Guangwu's meeting with Zhou Dang—to encourage integrity and shame and beautify custom—this too is fitting. One certainly should not, like Fan Sheng, slander them, nor, like Zhang Kai, press demands upon them.

sentences.zh: 至於飾偽以邀譽，釣奇以驚俗，不食君祿而爭屠沽之利，不受小官而規卿相之位，名與實反，心與跡違，斯乃華士、少正卯之流，其得免於聖王之誅幸矣，尚何聘召之有哉！

translations.literal: As for those who adorn falsehood to win praise, angle for the strange to startle the vulgar, refuse the ruler's salary yet contend for the butcher's and peddler's profit, decline petty office yet scheme for minister and chancellor rank—name and substance opposed, heart and tracks at odds—these are the sort of flashy gentlemen and Shao Zheng Mao; that they escape the sage king's punishment is already fortunate—how much less any summons to office!
translations.idiomatic: As for those who adorn falsehood to win praise, angle for the strange to startle the vulgar, refuse the ruler's salary yet contend for the butcher's and peddler's profit, decline petty office yet scheme for minister and chancellor rank—name and substance opposed, heart and tracks at odds—these are the sort of flashy gentlemen and Shao Zheng Mao. That they escape the sage king's punishment is already fortunate—how much less any summons to office!

sentences.zh: 時又徵廣漢楊厚、江夏黃瓊。

translations.literal: At this time Yang Hou of Guanghan and Huang Qiong of Jiangxia were also summoned.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Yang Hou of Guanghan and Huang Qiong of Jiangxia were also summoned.

sentences.zh: 瓊，香之子也。

translations.literal: Qiong was the son of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qiong was the son of Huang Xiang.

sentences.zh: 厚既至，豫陳漢有三百五十年之厄以為戒，拜議郎。

translations.literal: When Hou had arrived he beforehand set forth that Han would have a calamity at three hundred fifty years as a warning, and was appointed Gentleman Consultant.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Hou had arrived he beforehand set forth that Han would have a calamity at three hundred fifty years as a warning, and was appointed Gentleman Consultant.

sentences.zh: 瓊將至，李固以書逆遺之曰：「君子謂伯夷隘，柳下惠不恭。

translations.literal: As Qiong was about to arrive, Li Gu with a letter went to meet and present it to him, saying: "The gentleman says Boyi was narrow and Liuxia Hui was not respectful.
translations.idiomatic: As Huang Qiong was about to arrive, Li Gu with a letter went to meet and present it to him, saying, "The gentleman says Boyi was narrow and Liuxia Hui was not respectful.

sentences.zh: 不夷不惠，可否之間，聖賢居身之所珍也。

translations.literal: Neither narrow nor disrespectful, in the interval of yes and no—this is what sages and worthies treasure in placing themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Neither narrow nor disrespectful, in the interval of yes and no—this is what sages and worthies treasure in placing themselves.

sentences.zh: 誠遂欲枕山棲谷，擬跡巢、由，斯則可矣；

translations.literal: If you truly wish to pillow the mountains and nest in valleys, taking as model the tracks of Chao and You, that may do;
translations.idiomatic: If you truly wish to pillow the mountains and nest in valleys, taking as model the tracks of Chao and You, that may do;

sentences.zh: 若當輔政濟民，今其時也。

translations.literal: if you ought to assist government and succor the people, now is the time.
translations.idiomatic: if you ought to assist government and succor the people, now is the time.

sentences.zh: 自生民以來，善政少而亂俗多，必待堯、舜之君，此為士行其志終無時矣。

translations.literal: From the birth of the people, good government has been few and chaotic custom many; to insist on waiting for rulers like Yao and Shun—then for scholars to practice their intent there will never be a time.
translations.idiomatic: From the birth of the people, good government has been few and chaotic custom many. To insist on waiting for rulers like Yao and Shun—then for scholars to practice their intent there will never be a time.

sentences.zh: 常聞語曰：『嶢嶢者易缺，皦皦者易污。

translations.literal: I have often heard the saying: 'The towering is easily broken; the dazzling is easily stained.
translations.idiomatic: I have often heard the saying, 'The towering is easily broken; the dazzling is easily stained.

sentences.zh: 』盛名之下，其實難副。

translations.literal: ' Under great fame, the substance is hard to match.
translations.idiomatic: ' Under great fame, the substance is hard to match.

sentences.zh: 近魯陽樊君被徵，初至，朝廷設壇席，猶待神明，雖無大異，而言行所守，亦無所缺；

translations.literal: Recently the Master of Luyang, Fan, was summoned; when he first arrived the court set up altar and mat as if awaiting a spirit. Though there was no great difference, in word and conduct what he upheld was not lacking;
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Master of Luyang, Fan Ying, was summoned. When he first arrived the court set up altar and mat as if awaiting a spirit. Though there was no great difference, in word and conduct what he upheld was not lacking;

sentences.zh: 而毀謗布流，應時折減者，豈非觀聽望深，聲名太盛乎！

translations.literal: yet slander spread abroad and he was at once diminished—is it not because what observers hoped for was deep and his fame too great!
translations.idiomatic: yet slander spread abroad and he was at once diminished—is it not because what observers hoped for was deep and his fame too great!

sentences.zh: 是故俗論皆言『處士純盜虛聲』。

translations.literal: Therefore vulgar opinion all says 'recluses purely steal empty fame.'
translations.idiomatic: Therefore vulgar opinion all says 'recluses purely steal empty fame.'

sentences.zh: 願先生弘此遠謨，令眾人歎服，一雪此言耳！

translations.literal: I wish you, sir, would expand this far-reaching plan, make the multitude sigh in admiration, and once wash away this saying!
translations.idiomatic: I wish you, sir, would expand this far-reaching plan, make the multitude sigh in admiration, and once wash away this saying!

sentences.zh: 」瓊至，拜議郎，稍遷尚書僕射。

translations.literal: " When Qiong arrived he was appointed Gentleman Consultant and was gradually promoted to Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: " When Huang Qiong arrived he was appointed Gentleman Consultant and was gradually promoted to Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 瓊昔隨父在台閣，習見故事；

translations.literal: Qiong had formerly followed his father in the terrace offices and was practiced in precedents;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qiong had formerly followed his father in the terrace offices and was practiced in precedents;

sentences.zh: 及後居職，達練官曹，爭議朝堂，莫能抗奪。

translations.literal: when he later held office he was thoroughly versed in the bureaus; in debate at court none could withstand or overturn him.
translations.idiomatic: when he later held office he was thoroughly versed in the bureaus. In debate at court none could withstand or overturn him.

sentences.zh: 數上疏言事，上頗採用之。

translations.literal: He several times submitted memorials on affairs, and the emperor quite adopted his proposals.
translations.idiomatic: He several times submitted memorials on affairs, and the emperor quite adopted his proposals.

sentences.zh: 李固，郃之子，少好學，常改易姓名，杖策驅驢，負笈從師，不遠千里，遂究覽墳籍，為世大儒。

translations.literal: Li Gu was the son of He; from youth he loved learning, often changed his name, staff in hand drove a donkey, carried a book box to follow teachers—not shrinking from a thousand li—and thus thoroughly perused the classics, becoming a great Confucian of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu was the son of Li He. From youth he loved learning, often changed his name, staff in hand drove a donkey, and carried a book box to follow teachers—not shrinking from a thousand li—and thus thoroughly perused the classics, becoming a great Confucian of the age.

sentences.zh: 每到太學，密入公府，定省父母，不令同業諸生知其為郃子也。

translations.literal: Whenever he reached the Imperial Academy he would secretly enter his father's offices to attend his parents morning and evening, not letting fellow students know he was He's son.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he reached the Imperial Academy he would secretly enter his father's offices to attend his parents morning and evening, not letting fellow students know he was Li He's son.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on bingzi, the capital had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on bingzi day, the capital had an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 夏，六月，旱。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the sixth month, there was drought.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，丁酉，茂陵園寢災。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingyou, the park lodge at Maoling Mausoleum burned.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on dingyou day, the park lodge at Maoling Mausoleum burned.

sentences.zh: 九月，鮮卑寇漁陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Xianbei raided Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Xianbei raided Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 冬，十二月，己亥，太傅桓焉免。

translations.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on jihai, Grand Tutor Huan Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the twelfth month, on jihai day, Grand Tutor Huan Yan was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍來歷罷。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Lai Li was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry Lai Li was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 南單于拔死，弟休利立，為去特若屍逐就單于。

translations.literal: The Southern Chanyu Ba died; his younger brother Xiuli was established as Chanyu Qute Ruoshizhu Jiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Chanyu Ba died. His younger brother Xiuli was established as Chanyu Qute Ruoshizhu Jiu.

sentences.zh: 帝悉召孫程等還京師。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Sun Cheng and the others all back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Sun Cheng and the others all back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙寅，赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on bingyin, all under heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on bingyin day, all under heaven was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝加元服。

translations.literal: On bingzi the emperor performed the capping ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the emperor performed the capping ceremony.

sentences.zh: 夏，五月，壬辰，詔曰：「海內頗有災異，朝廷修政，太官減膳，珍玩不御。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on renchen, an edict said: "Within the seas there are rather many disasters and portents; the court is reforming government, the Grand Provisioner has reduced meals, and precious curios are not used.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, on renchen day, an edict said, "Within the seas there are rather many disasters and portents. The court is reforming government, the Grand Provisioner has reduced meals, and precious curios are not used.

sentences.zh: 而桂陽太守文礱，不惟竭忠宣暢本朝，而遠獻大珠以求幸媚，今封以還之！

translations.literal: Yet Administrator of Guiyang Wen Yin not only failed to exhaust loyalty and proclaim and extend this court, but from afar presented great pearls to seek favor and flattery—now they are sealed and returned to him!"
translations.idiomatic: Yet Administrator of Guiyang Wen Yin not only failed to exhaust loyalty and proclaim and extend this court, but from afar presented great pearls to seek favor and flattery—now they are sealed and returned to him!"

sentences.zh: 五州雨水。

translations.literal: Five provinces had rain and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Five provinces had rain and flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，丁巳，太尉劉光、司空張皓免。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on dingsi, Grand Commandant Liu Guang and Minister of Works Zhang Hao were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, on dingsi day, Grand Commandant Liu Guang and Minister of Works Zhang Hao were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 尚書偵射虞詡上言：「安定、北地、上郡，山川險厄，沃野千里，土宜畜牧，水可溉漕。

translations.literal: Investigator of the Masters of Writing Yu Xu submitted a memorial, saying: "Anding, Beidi, and Shang commanderies have mountains and rivers perilous and narrow, fertile fields for a thousand li, soil fit for pasture, and water for irrigation and transport.
translations.idiomatic: Investigator of the Masters of Writing Yu Xu submitted a memorial, saying, "Anding, Beidi, and Shang commanderies have mountains and rivers perilous and narrow, fertile fields for a thousand li, soil fit for pasture, and water for irrigation and transport.

sentences.zh: 頃遭元元之災，眾羌內潰，郡縣兵荒，二十餘年。

translations.literal: Recently they suffered the common people's calamity; the many Qiang collapsed inward; commanderies and counties were desolate from war for more than twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Recently they suffered the common people's calamity. The many Qiang collapsed inward, and commanderies and counties were desolate from war for more than twenty years.

sentences.zh: 夫棄沃壤之饒，捐自然之財，不可謂利；

translations.literal: To abandon the richness of fertile soil and cast away nature's wealth cannot be called profit;
translations.idiomatic: To abandon the richness of fertile soil and cast away nature's wealth cannot be called profit;

sentences.zh: 離河山之阻，守無險之處，難以為固。

translations.literal: to leave the barriers of rivers and mountains and guard places without peril is hard to make secure.
translations.idiomatic: to leave the barriers of rivers and mountains and guard places without peril is hard to make secure.

sentences.zh: 今三郡未復，園陵單外，而公卿選懦，容頭過身，張解設難，但計所費，不圖其安。

translations.literal: Now the three commanderies are not restored, the park mausoleums stand exposed alone, yet the dukes and ministers choose the timid, let the head pass and the body follow, spread excuses and set difficulties, reckoning only expense and not planning for security.
translations.idiomatic: Now the three commanderies are not restored and the park mausoleums stand exposed alone, yet the dukes and ministers choose the timid, let the head pass and the body follow, spread excuses and set difficulties, reckoning only expense and not planning for security.

sentences.zh: 宜開聖聽，考行所長。

translations.literal: Your sage hearing should be opened and what each excels at examined."
translations.idiomatic: Your sage hearing should be opened and what each excels at examined."

sentences.zh: 」九月，詔復安定、北地、上郡歸舊土。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month an edict restored Anding, Beidi, and Shang commanderies to their former lands.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month an edict restored Anding, Beidi, and Shang commanderies to their former lands.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以大鴻臚龐參為太尉、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Grand Herald Pang Can was made Grand Commandant and Recorder of Matters Relating to the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Grand Herald Pang Can was made Grand Commandant and Recorder of Matters Relating to the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 太常王龔為司空。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Gong was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Ceremonies Wang Gong was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，庚辰，司徒許敬免。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on gengchen, Minister over the Masses Xu Jing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the eleventh month, on gengchen day, Minister over the Masses Xu Jing was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑寇朔方。

translations.literal: The Xianbei raided Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei raided Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，巳卯，以宗正弘農劉崎為司徒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on sijimao day, made Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Qi of Hongnong Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on sijimao day, Director of the Imperial Clan Liu Qi of Hongnong was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 是歲，於窴王放前殺拘彌王興，自立其子為拘彌王，而遣使者貢獻，敦煌太守徐由上求討之。

translations.literal: That year King Fangqian of Yutian killed King Xing of Jimi, installed his own son as king of Jimi, and sent envoys with tribute. Administrator of Dunhuang Xu You memorialized above requesting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: That year King Fangqian of Yutian killed King Xing of Jimi, installed his own son as king of Jimi, and sent envoys with tribute. Administrator of Dunhuang Xu You memorialized requesting that he be punished.

sentences.zh: 帝赦於窴罪，令歸拘彌國；

translations.literal: The emperor pardoned Yutian's crime and ordered return of the Jimi state;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned Yutian's crime and ordered the return of the Jimi state;

sentences.zh: 放前不肯。

translations.literal: Fangqian refused.
translations.idiomatic: Fangqian refused.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，京師旱。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the capital suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, the capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 京師及郡國十二蝗。

translations.literal: The capital and twelve commanderies and states suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: The capital and twelve commanderies and states suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 定遠侯班超之孫始尚帝姑陰城公主。

translations.literal: Marquis Dingyuan Ban Shi's grandson Shi married the emperor's paternal aunt, the Princess of Yincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Dingyuan Ban Shi's grandson Shi married the emperor's paternal aunt, the Princess of Yincheng.

sentences.zh: 主驕淫無道；

translations.literal: The princess was arrogant, dissolute, and lawless;
translations.idiomatic: The princess was arrogant, dissolute, and lawless;

sentences.zh: 始積忿怒，伏刃殺主。
