translations.literal: Shi accumulated resentment and anger, lay in wait with a blade, and killed the princess.
translations.idiomatic: Shi accumulated resentment and anger, lay in wait with a blade, and killed the princess.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，乙亥，始坐腰斬，同產皆棄市。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on yihai day, Shi was sentenced to execution at the waist; all siblings born of the same mother were exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on yihai day, Shi was sentenced to execution at the waist, and all siblings born of the same mother were exposed in the market.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，庚午，河間孝王開薨；

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on gengwu day, Filial King Kai of Hejian died;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on gengwu day, Filial King Kai of Hejian died;

sentences.zh: 子政嗣。

translations.literal: His son Zheng succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zheng succeeded.

sentences.zh: 政傲很不奉法，帝以侍御史吳郡沈景有強能，擢為河間相。

translations.literal: Zheng was arrogant and defiant and did not follow the law. The emperor, because Attending Clerk Shen Jing of Wu commandery had strong ability, promoted him to Chancellor of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng was arrogant and defiant and did not follow the law. The emperor, because Attending Clerk Shen Jing of Wu commandery had strong ability, promoted him to Chancellor of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 景到國，謁王，王不正服，箕踞殿上；

translations.literal: Jing reached the state, called on the king; the king was not properly dressed and sat sprawled on the hall dais;
translations.idiomatic: When Jing reached the state and called on the king, the king was not properly dressed and sat sprawled on the hall dais;

sentences.zh: 侍郎贊拜，景峙不為禮，問王所在。

translations.literal: a Gentleman Attendant prompted the bow of courtesy; Jing stood erect and made no courtesy, asking where the king was.
translations.idiomatic: a Gentleman Attendant prompted the bow of courtesy. Jing stood erect and made no courtesy, asking where the king was.

sentences.zh: 虎賁曰：「是非王邪！

translations.literal: A Tiger Brave said: "Is this not the king!
translations.idiomatic: A Tiger Brave said, "Is this not the king!

sentences.zh: 」景曰：「王不正服，常人何別！

translations.literal: " Jing said: "The king is not properly dressed—how is he different from an ordinary man!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing said, "The king is not properly dressed—how is he different from an ordinary man!

sentences.zh: 今相謁王，豈謁無禮者邪！

translations.literal: " Now the chancellor calls on the king—does he call on one without courtesy!
translations.idiomatic: " Now the chancellor calls on the king—does he call on one without courtesy!

sentences.zh: 」王慚而更服，景然後拜；

translations.literal: " The king was ashamed and changed into proper dress; Jing then bowed;
translations.idiomatic: " The king was ashamed and changed into proper dress; Jing then bowed;

sentences.zh: 出，住宮門外，請王傅責之曰：「前發京師，陛見受詔，以王不恭，使相檢督。

translations.literal: going out, he stopped outside the palace gate and summoned the king's tutor to reprove him, saying: "Before leaving the capital I had audience and received an edict, because the king was disrespectful, to have the chancellor inspect and supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Going out, he stopped outside the palace gate and summoned the king's tutor to reprove him, saying, "Before leaving the capital I had audience and received an edict, because the king was disrespectful, to have the chancellor inspect and supervise.

sentences.zh: 諸君空受爵祿，曾無訓導之義！

translations.literal: " You gentlemen vainly receive rank and salary yet utterly lack the duty of instruction and guidance!
translations.idiomatic: " You gentlemen vainly receive rank and salary yet utterly lack the duty of instruction and guidance!

sentences.zh: 」因奏治其罪，詔書讓政而詰責傅。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he memorialized to punish their offenses; an imperial edict reproved Zheng and sharply rebuked the tutor.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he memorialized to punish their offenses. An imperial edict reproved Zheng and sharply rebuked the tutor.

sentences.zh: 景因捕諸奸人，奏案其罪，殺戮尤惡者數十人，出冤獄百餘人。

translations.literal: Jing then arrested various wicked men, memorialized cases of their crimes, executed several tens of the most vicious, and released more than a hundred from unjust imprisonment.
translations.idiomatic: Jing then arrested various wicked men, memorialized cases of their crimes, executed several tens of the most vicious, and released more than a hundred from unjust imprisonment.

sentences.zh: 政遂為改節，悔過自修。

translations.literal: Zheng thereupon changed his conduct, repented of faults, and cultivated himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng thereupon changed his conduct, repented of his faults, and cultivated himself.

sentences.zh: 帝以伊吾膏腴之地，傍近西域，匈奴資之以為鈔暴；

translations.literal: The emperor, because Yiwu was fertile land lying close to the Western Regions, and the Xiongnu relied on it for raiding and plunder;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because Yiwu was fertile land lying close to the Western Regions and the Xiongnu relied on it for raiding and plunder,

sentences.zh: 三月，辛亥，復令開設屯田，如永元時事，置伊吾司馬一人。

translations.literal: in the third month, on xinhai day, again ordered the opening of military colonies as in the Yongyuan period, and stationed one Major of Yiwu.
translations.idiomatic: in the third month, on xinhai day, again ordered the opening of military colonies as in the Yongyuan period and stationed one Major of Yiwu.

sentences.zh: 初，安帝薄於藝文，博士不復講習，朋徒相視怠散，學舍頹敝，鞠為園蔬，或牧兒、蕘豎薪刈其下。

translations.literal: Earlier Emperor An was slight toward literary arts; Erudites no longer lectured and studied, students looked at one another in idleness and dispersion, school buildings fell into ruin, turned into vegetable gardens, and herd boys and firewood gatherers cut fuel beneath them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Emperor An was slight toward literary arts. Erudites no longer lectured and studied, students looked at one another in idleness and dispersion, school buildings fell into ruin and turned into vegetable gardens, and herd boys and firewood gatherers cut fuel beneath them.

sentences.zh: 將作大匠翟酺上疏請更修繕，誘進後學，帝從之。

translations.literal: Master of Works Zhai Pu submitted a memorial requesting renewed repair and ornament, to attract and advance later students; the emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Master of Works Zhai Pu submitted a memorial requesting renewed repair and ornament to attract and advance later students, and the emperor followed it.

sentences.zh: 秋，九月，繕起太學，凡所造構二百四十房，千八百五十室。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, the Imperial University was repaired and raised; in all structures built numbered two hundred forty chambers and one thousand eight hundred fifty rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the ninth month, the Imperial University was repaired and raised. In all, two hundred forty chambers and one thousand eight hundred fifty rooms were built.

sentences.zh: 護烏桓校尉耿曄遣兵擊鮮卑，破之。

translations.literal: Colonel Protector of the Wuhuan Geng Tan sent troops to attack the Xianbei and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel Protector of the Wuhuan Geng Tan sent troops to attack the Xianbei and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 護羌校尉韓皓轉湟中屯田置兩河間，以逼群羌。

translations.literal: Colonel Protector of the Qiang Han Hao moved the garrison farms of Huangzhong and established them between the Two Rivers to press the various Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel Protector of the Qiang Han Hao moved the garrison farms of Huangzhong and established them between the Two Rivers to press the various Qiang.

sentences.zh: 皓坐事徵，以張掖太守馬續代為校尉。

translations.literal: Hao was summoned because of an offense; Administrator of Zhangye Ma Xu was made colonel in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was summoned because of an offense, and Administrator of Zhangye Ma Xu was made colonel in his place.

sentences.zh: 兩河間羌以屯田近之，恐必見圖，乃解仇詛盟，各自儆備；

translations.literal: The Qiang between the Two Rivers, because the garrison farms were near them, feared they would surely be plotted against; thereupon they dissolved enmity and oath alliances and each took precautions;
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang between the Two Rivers, because the garrison farms were near them, feared they would surely be plotted against. Thereupon they dissolved enmity and oath alliances and each took precautions;

sentences.zh: 續上移屯田還湟中，羌意乃安。

translations.literal: Xu memorialized above to move the garrison farms back to Huangzhong, and the Qiang's minds then were at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Xu memorialized to move the garrison farms back to Huangzhong, and the Qiang's minds then were at ease.

sentences.zh: 帝欲立皇后，而貴人有寵者四人，莫知所建，議欲探籌，以神定選。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to establish an empress, but among honored ladies with favor there were four, and none knew whom to establish. Deliberation wished to draw lots to let the spirits fix the choice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to establish an empress, but among honored ladies with favor there were four, and none knew whom to establish. Deliberation wished to draw lots to let the spirits fix the choice.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射南郡胡廣與尚書馮翊郭虔、史敞上疏諫曰：「竊見詔書，以立後事大，謙大自專，欲假之籌策，決疑靈神；

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Hu Guang of Nan commandery together with Directors Guo Qian of Fengyi and Shi Chang submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: "Your servant has seen the edict, that establishing the empress is a great affair, and in great humility one would not decide alone, wishing to borrow lots and stratagems and let numinous spirits resolve doubt;
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Secretariat Hu Guang of Nan commandery together with Directors Guo Qian of Fengyi and Shi Chang submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying, "Your servant has seen the edict, that establishing the empress is a great affair, and in great humility one would not decide alone, wishing to borrow lots and stratagems and let numinous spirits resolve doubt;

sentences.zh: 篇籍所記，祖宗典故，未嘗有也。

translations.literal: " What the classics and records note, the ancestral precedents, have never had this.
translations.idiomatic: " What the classics and records note, the ancestral precedents, have never had this.

sentences.zh: 恃神任筮，既不必當賢；

translations.literal: " Relying on spirits and trusting divination, one will not necessarily obtain the worthy;
translations.idiomatic: " Relying on spirits and trusting divination, one will not necessarily obtain the worthy;

sentences.zh: 就值其人，猶非德選。

translations.literal: " even if one happens on the right person, it is still not selection by virtue.
translations.idiomatic: " even if one happens on the right person, it is still not selection by virtue.

sentences.zh: 夫歧嶷形於自然，俔天必有異表，宜參良家，簡求有德，德同以年，年鈞以貌；

translations.literal: " Precocious intelligence takes form from nature; resemblance to heaven surely has an unusual appearance. It is fitting to consult good families, select and seek the virtuous—where virtue is equal, use age; where age is equal, use appearance;
translations.idiomatic: " Precocious intelligence takes form from nature; resemblance to heaven surely has an unusual appearance. It is fitting to consult good families, select and seek the virtuous—where virtue is equal, use age; where age is equal, use appearance;

sentences.zh: 稽之典經，斷之聖慮。

translations.literal: " examine against the canonical classics and decide by the sage's deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " examine against the canonical classics and decide by the sage's deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed it.

sentences.zh: 恭懷皇后弟子乘氏侯商之女，選入掖庭為貴人，常特被引御，從容辭曰：「夫陽以博施為德，陰以不專為義。

translations.literal: The niece of Empress Gonghuai, daughter of Marquis Shang of Chengyi, was selected into the Palace Rear Apartments as an Honored Lady and was often specially summoned for the emperor's company. She calmly declined, saying: "Yang takes broad bestowal as virtue; yin takes not being exclusive as righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The niece of Empress Gonghuai, daughter of Marquis Shang of Chengyi, was selected into the Palace Rear Apartments as an Honored Lady and was often specially summoned for the emperor's company. She calmly declined, saying, "Yang takes broad bestowal as virtue; yin takes not being exclusive as righteousness.

sentences.zh: 《螽斯》則百福所由興也。

translations.literal: " The "Zhongsi" is where the hundred blessings arise.
translations.idiomatic: " The "Zhongsi" is where the hundred blessings arise.

sentences.zh: 願陛下思雲雨之均澤，小妾得免於罪。

translations.literal: " Your servant wishes Your Majesty to think of the even moisture of cloud and rain, that your humble servant may escape offense.
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant wishes Your Majesty to think of the even moisture of cloud and rain, that your humble servant may escape offense.

sentences.zh: 」帝由是賢之。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereby regarded her as worthy.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereby regarded her as worthy.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，乙巳，立貴人梁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on yisi day, established Honored Lady Liang as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on yisi day, Honored Lady Liang was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 京師旱。

translations.literal: The capital suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: The capital suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三月，揚州六郡妖賊章河等寇四十九縣，殺傷長吏。

translations.literal: In the third month, demon bandits Zhang He and others of six Yangzhou commanderies raided forty-nine counties and killed and wounded chief officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, demon bandits Zhang He and others of six Yangzhou commanderies raided forty-nine counties and killed and wounded chief officials.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, amnestied the realm and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the realm was amnestied and the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，梁商加位特進；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Liang Shang was given the additional rank of Special Advance;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Liang Shang was given the additional rank of Special Advance;

sentences.zh: 頃之，拜執金吾。

translations.literal: before long he was appointed Commandant of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: before long he was appointed Commandant of Justice.

sentences.zh: 冬，耿曄遣烏桓戎末魔等鈔擊鮮卑，大獲而還。

translations.literal: In winter, Geng Tan sent the Wuhuan Rongmomo and others to raid the Xianbei, gained greatly, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, Geng Tan sent the Wuhuan Rongmomo and others to raid the Xianbei, gained greatly, and returned.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑復寇遼東屬國，耿曄移屯遼東無慮城以拒之。

translations.literal: The Xianbei again raided the Dependent State of Liaodong; Geng Tan moved his encampment to Wulü city in Liaodong to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei again raided the Dependent State of Liaodong. Geng Tan moved his encampment to Wulü city in Liaodong to resist them.

sentences.zh: 尚書令左雄上疏曰：「昔宣帝以為吏數變易，則下不安業；

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Zuo Xiong submitted a memorial, saying: "Formerly Emperor Xuan held that if officials were repeatedly changed, then inferiors would not settle in their occupations;
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Zuo Xiong submitted a memorial, saying, "Formerly Emperor Xuan held that if officials were repeatedly changed, then inferiors would not settle in their occupations;

sentences.zh: 久於其事，則民服教化。

translations.literal: " long in their affairs, then the people submit to transformation and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: " long in their affairs, then the people submit to transformation and instruction.

sentences.zh: 其有政治者，輒以璽書勉勵，增秩賜金，公卿缺則以次用之。

translations.literal: " Those who had good government were at once encouraged by imperial rescript with seal, given increased rank and bestowed gold; when public ministers and excellencies were vacant, they were used in order.
translations.idiomatic: " Those who had good government were at once encouraged by imperial rescript with seal, given increased rank and bestowed gold. When public ministers and excellencies were vacant, they were used in order.

sentences.zh: 是以吏稱其職，民安其業，漢世良吏，於茲為盛。

translations.literal: " Thus officials matched their duties and the people were secure in their occupations; good officials of the Han age reached their greatest abundance then.
translations.idiomatic: " Thus officials matched their duties and the people were secure in their occupations. Good officials of the Han age reached their greatest abundance then.

sentences.zh: 今典城百里，轉動無常，各懷一切，莫慮長久。

translations.literal: " Today those governing cities of a hundred li shift without constancy; each harbors a one-time expedient and none considers the long term.
translations.idiomatic: " Today those governing cities of a hundred li shift without constancy. Each harbors a one-time expedient and none considers the long term.

sentences.zh: 謂殺害不辜為威風，聚斂整辦為賢能；

translations.literal: " They call killing the innocent "prestigious wind," and gathering and levying with tight preparation "worth and ability;"
translations.idiomatic: " They call killing the innocent "prestigious wind," and gathering and levying with tight preparation "worth and ability;"

sentences.zh: 以治己安民為劣弱，奉法循理為不治。

translations.literal: " they take governing oneself and securing the people as inferior weakness, and following law and adhering to principle as non-government.
translations.idiomatic: " they take governing oneself and securing the people as inferior weakness, and following law and adhering to principle as non-government.

sentences.zh: 髡鉗之戮，生於睚眥；

translations.literal: " punishments of shaving and shackling arise from the glance of an eye;
translations.idiomatic: " punishments of shaving and shackling arise from the glance of an eye;

sentences.zh: 覆屍之禍，成於喜怒。

translations.literal: " disasters of corpses heaped over one another are completed from joy and anger.
translations.idiomatic: " disasters of corpses heaped over one another are completed from joy and anger.

sentences.zh: 視民如寇仇，稅之如豺虎。

translations.literal: " They regard the people as bandit enemies and tax them like jackals and tigers.
translations.idiomatic: " They regard the people as bandit enemies and tax them like jackals and tigers.

sentences.zh: 監司項背相望，與同疾疢，見非不舉，聞惡不察。

translations.literal: " Supervisors and inspectors stand back to back in sight, sharing the same disease—seeing wrong and not reporting it, hearing evil and not investigating.
translations.idiomatic: " Supervisors and inspectors stand back to back in sight, sharing the same disease—seeing wrong and not reporting it, hearing evil and not investigating.

sentences.zh: 觀政於亭傳，責成於期月；

translations.literal: " They observe government at post stations and demand achievement within a month;
translations.idiomatic: " They observe government at post stations and demand achievement within a month;

sentences.zh: 言善不稱德，論功不據實。

translations.literal: " speaking of goodness without weighing virtue, discussing merit without basing on fact.
translations.idiomatic: " speaking of goodness without weighing virtue, discussing merit without basing on fact.

sentences.zh: 虛誕者獲譽，拘檢者離毀；

translations.literal: " the empty and false gain praise; the restrained and careful meet slander;
translations.idiomatic: " the empty and false gain praise; the restrained and careful meet slander;

sentences.zh: 或因罪而引高，或色斯而求名，州宰不覆，競共辟召，踴躍升騰，超等逾匹。

translations.literal: " some, because of crime, draw themselves high; some, seeing the color, seek fame. Prefects do not review them; they compete in summoning and appointing, leaping and soaring upward, surpassing rank and exceeding peers.
translations.idiomatic: " some, because of crime, draw themselves high; some, seeing the color, seek fame. Prefects do not review them. They compete in summoning and appointing, leaping and soaring upward, surpassing rank and exceeding peers.

sentences.zh: 或考奏捕案，而亡不受罪，會赦行賂，復見洗滌，朱紫同色，清濁不分。

translations.literal: " Some are examined and memorialized for arrest and trial yet flee and do not receive punishment; when an amnesty comes they go with bribes and are again washed clean—vermilion and purple the same color, clear and turbid undivided.
translations.idiomatic: " Some are examined and memorialized for arrest and trial yet flee and do not receive punishment. When an amnesty comes they go with bribes and are again washed clean—vermilion and purple the same color, clear and turbid undivided.

sentences.zh: 故使奸猾枉濫，輕忽去就，拜除如流，缺動百數。

translations.literal: " Therefore the crafty and slippery run wild, lightly heed coming and going, appointments and dismissals flow like water, and vacancies stir by the hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: " Therefore the crafty and slippery run wild, lightly heed coming and going, appointments and dismissals flow like water, and vacancies stir by the hundreds.

sentences.zh: 鄉官、部吏，職賤祿薄，車馬衣服，一出於民，廉者取足，貪者充家；

translations.literal: " Village officers and department clerks have mean duties and thin salaries, yet carriage, horse, and clothing all come from the people—the honest take enough, the greedy fill their houses;
translations.idiomatic: " Village officers and department clerks have mean duties and thin salaries, yet carriage, horse, and clothing all come from the people—the honest take enough, the greedy fill their houses;

sentences.zh: 特選、橫調，紛紛不絕，送迎煩費，損政傷民。

translations.literal: " special selections and forced levies follow one another without cease; the trouble and expense of seeing off and welcoming harm government and injure the people.
translations.idiomatic: " special selections and forced levies follow one another without cease. The trouble and expense of seeing off and welcoming harm government and injure the people.

sentences.zh: 和氣未洽，災眚不消，咎皆在此。

translations.literal: " Harmonious qi is not attained, disasters and omens are not dispelled—the blame all lies here.
translations.idiomatic: " Harmonious qi is not attained, disasters and omens are not dispelled—the blame all lies here.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為守相、長吏惠和有顯效者，可就增秩，勿移徙；

translations.literal: " Your servant foolishly thinks that where prefects, chancellors, and chief officials have kindness and harmony with clear effect, one may increase their rank in place and not transfer them;
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant foolishly thinks that where prefects, chancellors, and chief officials have kindness and harmony with clear effect, one may increase their rank in place and not transfer them;

sentences.zh: 非父母喪，不得去官。

translations.literal: " except for parents' mourning they may not leave office.
translations.idiomatic: " except for parents' mourning they may not leave office.

sentences.zh: 其不從法禁，不式王命，錮之終身，雖會赦令，不得齒列。

translations.literal: " Those who do not follow legal prohibitions and do not model the king's command should be barred for life; though they meet an amnesty edict, they may not be ranked in the roster.
translations.idiomatic: " Those who do not follow legal prohibitions and do not model the king's command should be barred for life. Though they meet an amnesty edict, they may not be ranked in the roster.

sentences.zh: 若被劾奏，亡不就法者，徙家邊郡，以懲其後。

translations.literal: " If impeached and memorialized yet they flee and do not submit to law, move their families to frontier commanderies to warn those who come after.
translations.idiomatic: " If impeached and memorialized yet they flee and do not submit to law, move their families to frontier commanderies to warn those who come after.

sentences.zh: 其鄉部親民之吏，皆用儒生清白任從政者，寬其負算，增其秩祿；

translations.literal: " As for officers of villages and departments who are close to the people, all should employ Confucian scholars who are pure and clear and fit for government, relax their tax assessments, and increase their rank and salary;
translations.idiomatic: " As for officers of villages and departments who are close to the people, all should employ Confucian scholars who are pure and clear and fit for government, relax their tax assessments, and increase their rank and salary;

sentences.zh: 吏職滿歲，宰府州郡乃得辟舉。

translations.literal: " only when an officer's duty is full for a year may the prefect's office, the commandery, or the province summon and recommend.
translations.idiomatic: " only when an officer's duty is full for a year may the prefect's office, the commandery, or the province summon and recommend.

sentences.zh: 如此，威福之路塞，虛偽之端絕，送迎之役損，賦斂之源息，循理之吏得成其化，率土之民各寧其所矣。

translations.literal: " If so, the road of authority and favor is blocked, the source of emptiness and falsehood is cut off, the labor of seeing off and welcoming is reduced, the spring of levies and collections is stilled, officers who follow principle can complete their transformation, and the people of the whole realm each secure their place.
translations.idiomatic: " If so, the road of authority and favor is blocked, the source of emptiness and falsehood is cut off, the labor of seeing off and welcoming is reduced, the spring of levies and collections is stilled, officers who follow principle can complete their transformation, and the people of the whole realm each secure their place.

sentences.zh: 」帝感其言，復申無故去官之禁，又下有司考吏治真偽，詳所施行；

translations.literal: " The emperor was moved by his words, again proclaimed the prohibition on leaving office without cause, and also ordered the relevant offices to examine officials' government for truth and falsehood, detailing what was implemented;
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was moved by his words, again proclaimed the prohibition on leaving office without cause, and also ordered the relevant offices to examine officials' government for truth and falsehood, detailing what was implemented;

sentences.zh: 而宦官不便，終不能行。

translations.literal: " but the eunuchs found it inconvenient, and in the end it could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: " but the eunuchs found it inconvenient, and in the end it could not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 雄又上言：「孔子曰：『四十不惑』，《禮》稱強仕。

translations.literal: Xiong again submitted words: "Confucius said: 'At forty one is free of doubt'; the Rites call it strong service.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong again submitted words, "Confucius said, 'At forty one is free of doubt'; the Rites call it strong service.

sentences.zh: 請自今，孝廉年不滿四十，不得察舉，皆先詣公府，諸生試家法，文吏課箋奏，副之端門，練其虛實，以觀異能，以美風俗。

translations.literal: " Your servant requests that from today Filial and Incorrupt candidates under forty years of age may not be examined and recommended; all should first go to the public offices—students tested on family learning, clerical officials examined on memorials and reports—copies posted at the Duan Gate to sift emptiness and substance, observe unusual ability, and beautify custom.
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant requests that from today Filial and Incorrupt candidates under forty years of age may not be examined and recommended. All should first go to the public offices—students tested on family learning, clerical officials examined on memorials and reports—copies posted at the Duan Gate to sift emptiness and substance, observe unusual ability, and beautify custom.

sentences.zh: 有不承科令者，正其罪法。

translations.literal: " Those who do not accept the regulations and orders—correct them by penal law.
translations.idiomatic: " Those who do not accept the regulations and orders—correct them by penal law.

sentences.zh: 若有茂材異行，自可不拘年齒。

translations.literal: " If there are flourishing talent and unusual conduct, naturally age need not be restricted.
translations.idiomatic: " If there are flourishing talent and unusual conduct, naturally age need not be restricted.

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed it.

sentences.zh: 胡廣、郭虔、史敞上書駁之曰：「凡選舉因才，無拘定制。

translations.literal: Hu Guang, Guo Qian, and Shi Chang submitted a memorial refuting it, saying: "In general selection and recommendation follow talent, without restriction to fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Guang, Guo Qian, and Shi Chang submitted a memorial refuting it, saying, "In general selection and recommendation follow talent, without restriction to fixed regulations.

sentences.zh: 六奇之策，不出經學；

translations.literal: " The six marvelous stratagems did not come from classical learning;
translations.idiomatic: " The six marvelous stratagems did not come from classical learning;

sentences.zh: 鄭、阿之政，非必章奏；

translations.literal: " the government of Zheng and A was not necessarily by formal memorial;
translations.idiomatic: " the government of Zheng and A was not necessarily by formal memorial;

sentences.zh: 甘、奇顯用，年乖強仁；

translations.literal: " Gan and Qi were prominently employed though their years fell short of strong service;
translations.idiomatic: " Gan and Qi were prominently employed though their years fell short of strong service;

sentences.zh: 終、賈揚聲，亦在弱冠。

translations.literal: " Zhong and Jia raised their fame also in the weak-capping years.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhong and Jia raised their fame also in the weak-capping years.

sentences.zh: 前世以來，貢舉之制，莫或回革。

translations.literal: " From former ages until now, the system of tribute recommendation has had none who turned and reformed it.
translations.idiomatic: " From former ages until now, the system of tribute recommendation has had none who turned and reformed it.

sentences.zh: 今以一臣之言，剷戾舊章，便利未明，眾心不厭。

translations.literal: " Now on one minister's words to cut and violate old statutes, the benefit is not clear and the hearts of the multitude are not satisfied.
translations.idiomatic: " Now on one minister's words to cut and violate old statutes, the benefit is not clear and the hearts of the multitude are not satisfied.

sentences.zh: 矯枉變常，政之所重，而不訪台司，不謀卿士，若事下之後，議者剝異，異之則朝失其便，同之則王言已行。

translations.literal: " To straighten the bent and change the constant is what government weighs heavily, yet without consulting the terrace offices or deliberating with ministers and nobles—if after the matter is sent down deliberators peel away in difference, to differ is for the court to lose its convenience, to agree is for the king's words already to have gone forth.
translations.idiomatic: " To straighten the bent and change the constant is what government weighs heavily, yet without consulting the terrace offices or deliberating with ministers and nobles—if after the matter is sent down deliberators peel away in difference, to differ is for the court to lose its convenience, to agree is for the king's words already to have gone forth.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為可宣下百官，參其同異，然後覽擇勝否，詳采厥衷。

translations.literal: " Your servant foolishly thinks it can be proclaimed down to the hundred officials, have them compare agreement and difference, and then survey and choose the winning and losing, carefully gathering the inner meaning.
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant foolishly thinks it can be proclaimed down to the hundred officials, have them compare agreement and difference, and then survey and choose the winning and losing, carefully gathering the inner meaning.

sentences.zh: 」帝不從。

translations.literal: " The emperor did not follow it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor did not follow it.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，初令「郡國舉孝廉，限年四十以上；

translations.literal: On xinmao day, for the first time ordered: "Commanderies and states recommending Filial and Incorrupt are limited to forty years of age and above;
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, for the first time it was ordered: "Commanderies and states recommending Filial and Incorrupt are limited to forty years of age and above;

sentences.zh: 諸生通章句，文吏能箋奏，乃得應選。

translations.literal: Students had to master chapter-and-verse commentary, clerical officials had to be able to draft memorials—only then could they qualify for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Students had to master chapter-and-verse commentary and clerical officials had to be able to draft memorials—only then could they qualify for selection.

sentences.zh: 其有茂才異行，若顏淵、子奇，不拘年齒。

translations.literal: Those with outstanding talent and exceptional conduct, such as Yan Yuan and Ziqi, were not bound by age.
translations.idiomatic: Those with outstanding talent and exceptional conduct, such as Yan Yuan and Ziqi, were not bound by age limits.

sentences.zh: 」久之，廣陵所舉孝廉徐淑，年未四十。

translations.literal: After some time, Xu Shu, a filial and incorrupt candidate recommended by Guangling, was not yet forty.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, Xu Shu, a filial and incorrupt candidate recommended by Guangling, was not yet forty.

sentences.zh: 台郎詰之，對曰：「詔書曰：『有如顏回、子奇，不拘年齒。

translations.literal: A bureau gentleman interrogated him; he replied: "The edict says: 'For those like Yan Hui and Ziqi, do not bind by age.'"
translations.idiomatic: A bureau gentleman interrogated him. He replied, "The edict says, 'For those like Yan Hui and Ziqi, do not bind by age.'"

sentences.zh: 』是故本郡以臣充選。

translations.literal: "Therefore my native commandery recommended your servant to fill the selection."
translations.idiomatic: "Therefore my native commandery recommended me to fill the selection."

sentences.zh: 」郎不能屈。

translations.literal: The gentleman could not refute him.
translations.idiomatic: The gentleman could not refute him.

sentences.zh: 左雄詰之曰：「昔顏回聞一知十，孝廉聞一知幾邪？

translations.literal: Zuo Xiong interrogated him, saying: "Formerly Yan Hui heard one thing and knew ten—how many does the filial candidate hear one and know?"
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Xiong interrogated him, saying, "Formerly Yan Hui heard one thing and knew ten—how many things does the filial candidate hear one and know?"

sentences.zh: 」淑無以對，乃罷卻之。

translations.literal: Shu had no reply and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Shu had no reply and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 郡守坐免。

translations.literal: The commandery administrator was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The commandery administrator was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 袁宏論曰：夫謀事作制，以經世訓物，必使可為也。

translations.literal: Yuan Hong commented: To plan affairs and establish institutions, to govern the age and instruct things, one must make them practicable.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hong commented: To plan affairs and establish institutions, to govern the age and instruct things, one must make them practicable.

sentences.zh: 古者四十而仕，非謂彈冠之會必將是年也。

translations.literal: In antiquity one took office at forty—this did not mean the moment of putting on one's cap must be exactly that year.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity one took office at forty—this did not mean one had to put on one's cap in exactly that year.

sentences.zh: 以為可事之時在於強盛，故舉其大限以為民衷。

translations.literal: It was held that the time when one could serve affairs was in one's prime strength, so they took this great limit as the people's standard.
translations.idiomatic: It was held that the time when one could handle affairs was in one's prime strength, so they took this upper limit as the people's standard.

sentences.zh: 且顏淵、子奇，曠代一有，而欲以斯為格，豈不偏乎！

translations.literal: Moreover Yan Yuan and Ziqi appear perhaps once in an age—yet to take them as the measure, would that not be skewed!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Yan Yuan and Ziqi appear perhaps once in an age—yet to take them as the standard, would that not be skewed!

sentences.zh: 然雄公直精明，能審核真偽，決志行之。

translations.literal: Yet Xiong was upright and keen, able to examine truth from falsehood, and resolved to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Xiong was upright and keen, able to distinguish truth from falsehood, and resolved to carry it out.

sentences.zh: 頃之，胡廣出為濟陰太守，與諸郡守十餘人皆坐謬舉免黜；

translations.literal: Before long, Hu Guang went out as Administrator of Jiyin, and more than ten commandery administrators including him were all dismissed for mistaken recommendations;
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Hu Guang went out as Administrator of Jiyin, and more than ten commandery administrators including him were all dismissed for mistaken recommendations;

sentences.zh: 唯汝南陳蕃、穎川李膺、下邳陳球等三十餘人得拜郎中。

translations.literal: only Chen Fan of Runan, Li Ying of Yingchuan, Chen Qiu of Xiapi, and more than thirty others were appointed as Palace Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: only Chen Fan of Runan, Li Ying of Yingchuan, Chen Qiu of Xiapi, and more than thirty others were appointed as Palace Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 自是牧、守畏栗，莫敢輕舉。

translations.literal: From this the governors and administrators were fearful and did not dare recommend lightly.
translations.idiomatic: From this the governors and administrators were fearful and did not dare recommend lightly.

sentences.zh: 迄於永嘉，察選清平，多得其人。

translations.literal: Down to the Yongjia era, examinations and selections were clear and even, and mostly obtained the right men.
translations.idiomatic: Down to the Yongjia era, examinations and selections were clear and fair, and mostly obtained the right men.

sentences.zh: 閏月，庚子，恭陵百丈廡災。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengzi day, the hundred-zhang gallery of Gong Mausoleum caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengzi day, the hundred-zhang gallery of Gong Mausoleum caught fire.

sentences.zh: 上聞北海郎顗精於陰陽之學。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that Lang Gu, Gentleman of Beihai, was expert in yin-yang studies.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor heard that Lang Gu, Gentleman of Beihai, was expert in yin-yang studies.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，詔公車徵顗，問以災異。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, an edict ordered the imperial carriage office to summon Gu and question him on calamities and prodigies.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, an edict ordered the imperial carriage office to summon Gu and question him on calamities and prodigies.

sentences.zh: 顗上章曰：「三公上應臺階，不同元首，政失其道，則寒陰反節。

translations.literal: Gu submitted a memorial, saying: "The Three Excellencies correspond to the terrace steps, different from the head; when government loses the Way, cold yin reverses the seasons."
translations.idiomatic: Gu submitted a memorial, saying, "The Three Excellencies correspond to the terrace steps, distinct from the sovereign; when government loses the Way, cold yin reverses the seasons."

sentences.zh: 今之在位，競托高虛，納累鐘之奉，亡天下之憂。

translations.literal: "Those now in office compete in resting on high emptiness, receive stipends stacked like bells, and lack care for all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: "Those now in office compete in resting on lofty emptiness, receive stipends heaped like bells, and lack care for all under heaven."

sentences.zh: 棲遲偃仰，寢疾自逸，被策文，得賜錢，即復起矣，何疾之易而愈之速！

translations.literal: "They linger reclining, feign illness and indulge ease; given an edict of appointment and granted money, they rise at once—how easily illness vanishes and recovery is swift!"
translations.idiomatic: "They linger reclining, feign illness and indulge in ease; given an edict of appointment and granted money, they rise at once—how easily illness vanishes and recovery is swift!"

sentences.zh: 以此消伏災眚，興致昇平，其可得乎！

translations.literal: "To eliminate calamities on this basis and bring rising peace—can it be obtained!"
translations.idiomatic: "To eliminate calamities on this basis and bring rising peace—how can it be obtained!"

sentences.zh: 今選牧、守，委任三府；

translations.literal: "Now in selecting governors and administrators, entrustment lies with the three offices;"
translations.idiomatic: "Now in selecting governors and administrators, entrustment lies with the three offices;"

sentences.zh: 長吏不良，既咎州、郡，州、郡有失，豈得不歸責舉者！

translations.literal: "when subordinate officials are bad, blame falls on province and commandery; when province and commandery err, how can blame not return on the recommenders!"
translations.idiomatic: "when subordinate officials are bad, blame falls on province and commandery; when province and commandery err, how can blame not return on those who recommended them!"

sentences.zh: 而陛下崇之彌優，自下慢事愈甚，所謂『大網疏，小網數』。

translations.literal: "Yet Your Majesty honors them ever more generously, while slackness below grows ever worse—this is what is called 'the great net is coarse, the small net is dense.'"
translations.idiomatic: "Yet Your Majesty honors them ever more generously, while slackness below grows ever worse—this is what is called 'the great net is coarse, the small net is dense.'"

sentences.zh: 三公非臣之仇，臣非狂夫之作，所以發憤忘食，懇懇不已者，誠念朝廷欲致興平。

translations.literal: "The Three Excellencies are not your servant's enemies; your servant is no madman's composition. The reason I forget food in indignation and plead unceasingly is truly that I think the court wishes to attain peace and thriving."
translations.idiomatic: "The Three Excellencies are not your servant's enemies, and your servant is no madman's scribbling. The reason I forget food in indignation and plead unceasingly is truly that I believe the court wishes to attain peace and thriving."

sentences.zh: 臣書不擇言，死不敢恨！

translations.literal: "Your servant's writing does not choose words; death I dare not resent!"
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant's writing does not choose words; I dare not resent death!"

sentences.zh: 」因條便宜七事：「一，園陵火災，宜念百姓之勞，罷繕修之役。

translations.literal: Thereupon he set forth seven expedient measures: "First, the park-mausoleum fire—consider the people's toil and halt repair labor."
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he set forth seven expedient measures: "First, the park-mausoleum fire—consider the people's toil and halt repair labor."

sentences.zh: 二，立春以後陰寒失節，宜採納良臣，以助聖化。

translations.literal: Second, after spring begins yin-cold loses the seasons—select and employ good ministers to aid sagely transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Second, after spring begins yin-cold loses the seasons—select and employ good ministers to aid sagely transformation.

sentences.zh: 三，今年少陽之歲，春當旱，夏必有水，宜遵前典，惟節惟約。

translations.literal: Third, this year is a lesser yang year—spring should bring drought, summer will surely bring flood—follow former canons, be frugal and restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Third, this year is a lesser yang year—spring should bring drought and summer will surely bring flood—follow former canons and be frugal and restrained.

sentences.zh: 四，去年八月，熒惑出入軒轅，宜簡出宮女，恣其姻嫁。

translations.literal: Fourth, last year in the eighth month Mars entered and left Xuanyuan—simplify and release palace women and let them marry as they will.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, last year in the eighth month Mars entered and left Xuanyuan—release palace women and let them marry as they will.

sentences.zh: 五，去年閏十月，有白氣從西方天苑趨參左足，入玉井，恐立秋以後，將有羌寇畔戾之患，宜豫宣告諸郡，嚴為備御。

translations.literal: Fifth, last year in the intercalary tenth month white vapors from the western Tianyuan rushed toward the left foot of Shen and entered Yujing—fearing that after Beginning of Autumn there may be Qiang raiders rebelling—announce to all commanderies in advance and strictly prepare defense.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, last year in the intercalary tenth month white vapors from the western Tianyuan rushed toward the left foot of Shen and entered Yujing—fearing that after Beginning of Autumn Qiang raiders may rebel—announce to all commanderies in advance and strictly prepare defenses.

sentences.zh: 六，今月十四日乙卯，白虹貫日，宜令中外官司，並須立秋然後考事。

translations.literal: Sixth, on the fourteenth of this month, yimao, a white rainbow pierced the sun—order central and external offices to examine affairs only after Beginning of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, on the fourteenth of this month, yimao, a white rainbow pierced the sun—order central and external offices to examine affairs only after Beginning of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 七，漢興以來三百三十九歲，於詩三期，宜大蠲法令，有所變更。

translations.literal: Seventh, since Han rose it has been three hundred thirty-nine years—in the Odes' three periods—greatly reduce statutes and make changes.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, since Han rose it has been three hundred thirty-nine years—in the Odes' three periods—greatly reduce statutes and make changes.

sentences.zh: 王者隨天，譬猶自春徂夏，改青服絳也。

translations.literal: The king follows Heaven, like proceeding from spring to summer, changing green garments for red.
translations.idiomatic: The king follows Heaven, like proceeding from spring to summer, changing green garments for red.

sentences.zh: 自文帝省刑，適三百年，而輕微之禁，漸已殷積。

translations.literal: From Emperor Wen's reduction of punishments, nearing three hundred years, yet light minor prohibitions have gradually piled up.
translations.idiomatic: From Emperor Wen's reduction of punishments, nearly three hundred years have passed, yet light minor prohibitions have gradually piled up.

sentences.zh: 王者之法，譬猶江、河，當使易避而難犯也。

translations.literal: The king's law is like the Yangtze and Yellow River—it should be easy to avoid and hard to violate.
translations.idiomatic: The king's law is like the Yangtze and Yellow River—it should be easy to avoid and hard to violate.

sentences.zh: 二月，顗復上書薦黃瓊、李固，以為宜加擢用。

translations.literal: In the second month, Gu again memorialized recommending Huang Qiong and Li Gu as fitting for special promotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Gu again memorialized recommending Huang Qiong and Li Gu as fitting for special promotion.

sentences.zh: 又言：「自冬涉春，訖無嘉澤，數有西風，反逆時節，朝廷勞心，廣為禱祈，薦祭山川，暴龍移市。

translations.literal: He also said: "From winter through spring there has been no good rain; several times west wind, reversing the seasons—the court labors in heart, widely prays, offers sacrifice to mountains and rivers, exposes the dragon and moves the market."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "From winter through spring there has been no good rain; west wind has come several times, reversing the seasons. The court labors in anxiety, widely prays, offers sacrifice to mountains and rivers, exposes the dragon image, and moves the market."

sentences.zh: 臣聞皇天感物，不為偽動；

translations.literal: "Your servant has heard August Heaven is moved by things, not by pretense;"
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant has heard that August Heaven is moved by things, not by pretense;"

sentences.zh: 災變應人，要在責己。

translations.literal: "prodigies respond to men—the key lies in blaming oneself."
translations.idiomatic: "prodigies respond to men—the key lies in blaming oneself."

sentences.zh: 若令雨可請降，水可攘止，則歲無隔並，太平可待。

translations.literal: "If rain could be requested and flood averted, then years without plague would follow and great peace could be awaited."
translations.idiomatic: "If rain could be requested and flood averted, then years without plague would follow and great peace could be awaited."

sentences.zh: 然而災害不息者，患不在此也。

translations.literal: "Yet calamities do not cease—the trouble lies not here."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet calamities do not cease—the trouble lies not here."

sentences.zh: 」書奏，特拜郎中；

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; he was specially appointed Palace Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; he was specially appointed Palace Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 辭病不就。

translations.literal: he pleaded illness and did not take the post.
translations.idiomatic: he pleaded illness and did not take the post.

sentences.zh: 三月，使匈奴中郎將趙稠遣從事將南匈奴兵出塞擊鮮卑，破之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the envoy Zhao Chou, Colonel of the Xiongnu, sent staff to lead Southern Xiongnu troops beyond the passes to strike the Xianbei and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Envoy Zhao Chou, Colonel of the Xiongnu, sent staff to lead Southern Xiongnu troops beyond the passes to strike the Xianbei and routed them.

sentences.zh: 初，帝之立也，乳母宋娥與其謀，帝封娥為山陽君，又封執金吾梁商子冀為襄邑侯。

translations.literal: Initially when the Emperor was established, wet nurse Song E shared in the plotting; the Emperor enfeoffed E as Lady of Shanyang, and also enfeoffed Liang Ji's son as Marquis of Xiangyi.
translations.idiomatic: Initially when the Emperor was established, wet nurse Song E shared in the plotting. The Emperor enfeoffed E as Lady of Shanyang and also enfeoffed Liang Ji's son as Marquis of Xiangyi.

sentences.zh: 尚書令左雄上封事曰：「高皇帝約，非劉氏不王，非有功不侯。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Zuo Xiong submitted a sealed memorial, saying: "Founding Emperor's covenant—none but Liu to be king, none without merit to be marquis."
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Zuo Xiong submitted a sealed memorial, saying, "The Founding Emperor's covenant: none but Liu to be king, none without merit to be marquis."

sentences.zh: 孝安皇帝封江京、王聖等，遂致地震之異。

translations.literal: "Emperor An enfeoffed Jiang Jing, Wang Sheng, and others, and thus brought earthquake prodigies."
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor An enfeoffed Jiang Jing, Wang Sheng, and others, and thus brought earthquake prodigies."

sentences.zh: 永建二年封陰謀之功，又有日食之變。

translations.literal: "In Yongjian year 2 enfeoffing those of secret plotting also brought solar eclipse changes."
translations.idiomatic: "In Yongjian year 2, enfeoffing those who had plotted in secret also brought solar eclipse prodigies."

sentences.zh: 數術之士，咸歸咎於封爵。

translations.literal: "Men of numerology all attributed it to enfeoffment."
translations.idiomatic: "Men of numerology all attributed it to enfeoffment."

sentences.zh: 今青州饑虛，盜賊未息，誠不宜追尋小恩，虧失大典。

translations.literal: "Now Qingzhou is famine-struck and empty, bandits not yet quelled—truly inappropriate to chase small favors and lose the great canon."
translations.idiomatic: "Now Qingzhou is famine-struck and empty and bandits are not yet quelled—it is truly inappropriate to chase small favors and lose the great canon."

sentences.zh: 」詔不聽。

translations.literal: The edict did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 雄復諫曰：「臣聞人君莫不好忠正而惡讒諛，然而歷世之患，莫不以忠正得罪，讒諛蒙幸者，蓋聽忠難，從諛易也。

translations.literal: Xiong remonstrated again, saying: "Your servant has heard that rulers all love loyalty and straightness and hate slander and flattery, yet through the ages the trouble has always been that the loyal and straight are punished while slanderers and flatterers receive favor—probably because hearing loyalty is hard and following flattery is easy."
translations.idiomatic: Xiong remonstrated again, saying, "Your servant has heard that rulers all love loyalty and straightness and hate slander and flattery, yet through the ages the trouble has always been that the loyal and straight are punished while slanderers and flatterers receive favor—probably because hearing loyalty is hard and following flattery is easy."

sentences.zh: 夫刑罪，人情之所甚惡，貴寵，人情之所甚欲，是以時俗為忠者少而習諛者多。

translations.literal: "Punishment and penalty are what human feelings greatly loathe; noble favor is what human feelings greatly desire—thus in the times those who act loyal are few and those who practice flattery are many."
translations.idiomatic: "Punishment and penalty are what people greatly loathe; noble favor is what people greatly desire—thus in the times those who act loyal are few and those who practice flattery are many."

sentences.zh: 故令人主數聞其美，稀知其過，迷而不悟，以至於危亡。

translations.literal: "Therefore rulers often hear their own praise and rarely know their faults, wander without awakening, and reach ruin."
translations.idiomatic: "Therefore rulers often hear their own praise and rarely know their faults, wander without awakening, and reach ruin."

sentences.zh: 臣伏見詔書，顧念阿母舊德宿恩，欲特加顯賞。

translations.literal: "Your servant has seen the edict, recalling foster mother's old virtue and long-standing grace, wishing to add special conspicuous reward."
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant has seen the edict, recalling the foster mother's old virtue and long-standing grace and wishing to add special conspicuous reward."

sentences.zh: 案尚書故事，無乳母爵邑之制，唯先帝時阿母王聖為野王君，聖造生讒賊廢立之禍，生為天下所咀嚼，死為海內所歡快。

translations.literal: "Checking Secretariat precedents, there is no institution of rank and fief for wet nurses—only under the former emperor foster mother Wang Sheng was made Lady of Yewang. Sheng gave birth to slanderers and the calamity of deposition and establishment; alive she was chewed over by all under heaven, dead she was rejoiced over within the seas."
translations.idiomatic: "Checking Secretariat precedents, there is no institution of rank and fief for wet nurses—only under the former emperor foster mother Wang Sheng was made Lady of Yewang. Sheng gave birth to slanderers and the calamity of deposition and establishment; alive she was reviled by all under heaven, dead she was rejoiced over within the seas."

sentences.zh: 桀、紂貴為天子，而庸僕羞與為比者，以其無義也；

translations.literal: "Jie and Zhou were exalted as Sons of Heaven, yet common servants were ashamed to be compared with them because they lacked righteousness;"
translations.idiomatic: "Jie and Zhou were exalted as Sons of Heaven, yet common servants were ashamed to be compared with them because they lacked righteousness;"

sentences.zh: 夷、齊賤為匹夫，而王侯爭與為伍者，以其有德也。

translations.literal: "Bo Yi and Shu Qi were base as commoners, yet kings and marquises competed to join their company because they had virtue."
translations.idiomatic: "Bo Yi and Shu Qi were base as commoners, yet kings and marquises competed to join their company because they had virtue."

sentences.zh: 今阿母躬蹈儉約，以身率下，群僚蒸庶，莫不向風。

translations.literal: "Now the foster mother personally practices thrift and restraint, leading those below by her person; officials and the masses all turn toward her wind."
translations.idiomatic: "Now the foster mother personally practices thrift and restraint and leads those below by her example; officials and the masses all turn toward her example."

sentences.zh: 而與王聖並同爵號，懼違本操，失其常願。

translations.literal: "Yet to share rank and title with Wang Sheng—I fear violating her original conduct and losing her constant wish."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet to share rank and title with Wang Sheng—I fear she would violate her original conduct and lose her constant wish."

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為凡人之心，理不相遠，其所不安，古今一也。

translations.literal: "Your servant foolishly holds that the hearts of ordinary men, in principle, are not far apart; what unsettles them is the same in antiquity and today."
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant foolishly holds that ordinary men's hearts, in principle, are not far apart; what unsettles them is the same in antiquity and today."

sentences.zh: 百姓深懲王聖傾覆之禍，民萌之命危於累卵，常懼時世復有此類，怵惕之念未離於心，恐懼之言未絕乎口。

translations.literal: "The people deeply punish Wang Sheng's overturning calamity; the common folk's lives were precarious as piled eggs—they constantly fear the age will again have such a type; thoughts of dread have not left their hearts, words of fear have not ceased from their mouths."
translations.idiomatic: "The people deeply punish Wang Sheng's overturning calamity; the common folk's lives were precarious as piled eggs. They constantly fear the age will again produce such a case; thoughts of dread have not left their hearts and words of fear have not ceased from their mouths."

sentences.zh: 乞如前議，歲以千萬給奉阿母，內足以盡恩愛之歡，外可不為吏民所怪。

translations.literal: "I beg as in the former proposal: yearly grant ten million for the foster mother's support—inwardly enough to fulfill affection's joy, outwardly not strange to officials and people."
translations.idiomatic: "I beg as in the former proposal: grant ten million yearly for the foster mother's support—inwardly enough to fulfill affection's joy, outwardly not strange to officials and people."

sentences.zh: 梁冀之封，事非機急，宜過災顧之運，然後平議可否。

translations.literal: "Liang Ji's enfeoffment is not urgent in the matter—it should pass the period when prodigies are watched, then calmly debate whether it is permissible."
translations.idiomatic: "Liang Ji's enfeoffment is not an urgent matter—it should wait until the period when prodigies are watched has passed, then calmly debate whether it is permissible."

sentences.zh: 」於是冀父商讓還冀封；

translations.literal: Thereupon Ji's father Shang yielded and returned Ji's fief;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Ji's father Shang yielded and returned Ji's fief;

sentences.zh: 書十餘上，帝乃從之。

translations.literal: more than ten memorials were submitted before the Emperor followed.
translations.idiomatic: more than ten memorials were submitted before the Emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，己亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jihai day, the capital had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on jihai day, the capital had an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月，庚子，詔群公、卿士各直言厥咎，仍各舉敦樸士一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered all dukes and ministers to speak plainly of their faults, and each also to recommend one plain and honest gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered all dukes and ministers to speak plainly of their faults, and each also to recommend one plain and honest gentleman.

sentences.zh: 左雄復上疏曰：「先帝封野王君，漢陽地震，今封山陽君而京城復震，專政在陰，其災尤大。

translations.literal: Zuo Xiong again memorialized, saying: "The former emperor enfeoffed Lady of Yewang and Hanyang had an earthquake; now enfeofing Lady of Shanyang and the capital again quakes—exclusive government lies in yin, and the calamity is especially great."
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Xiong again memorialized, saying, "The former emperor enfeoffed Lady of Yewang and Hanyang had an earthquake; now enfeofing Lady of Shanyang and the capital again quakes—exclusive government lies in yin, and the calamity is especially great."

sentences.zh: 臣前後瞽言，封爵至重，王者可私人以財，不可以官，宜還阿母之封以塞災異。

translations.literal: "Your servant's successive blind words: enfeoffment is extremely weighty—the king may give a person private wealth, not office; the foster mother's fief should be returned to block prodigies."
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant's successive blind words: enfeoffment is extremely weighty—the king may give a person private wealth, not office. The foster mother's fief should be returned to block prodigies."

sentences.zh: 今冀已高讓，山陽君亦宜崇其本節。

translations.literal: "Now Ji has loftily yielded; Lady of Shanyang should also honor her original integrity."
translations.idiomatic: "Now Ji has loftily yielded; Lady of Shanyang should also honor her original integrity."

sentences.zh: 」雄言切至，娥亦畏懼辭讓。

translations.literal: Xiong's words were sharp and thorough; E also feared and pleaded to yield.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong's words were sharp and thorough; E also feared and pleaded to yield.

sentences.zh: 而帝戀戀不能已，卒封之。

translations.literal: Yet the Emperor clung fondly and could not stop; in the end he enfeoffed her.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Emperor clung fondly and could not stop; in the end he enfeoffed her.

sentences.zh: 是時，大司農劉據以職事被譴，召詣尚書，傳呼促步，又加以捶撲。

translations.literal: At this time Grand Minister of Agriculture Liu Ju was reprimanded for official matters, summoned to the Secretariat, urged by criers to quicken his step, and also given beating and flogging.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Grand Minister of Agriculture Liu Ju was reprimanded for official matters, summoned to the Secretariat, urged by criers to quicken his step, and also beaten and flogged.

sentences.zh: 雄上言：「九卿位亞三事，班在大臣，行有佩玉之節，動有癢序之儀。

translations.literal: Xiong memorialized, saying: "The Nine Ministers rank next to the three duties, classed among great ministers; in walking they have the ritual of jade pendants, in movement the ceremony of itch-and-order."
translations.idiomatic: Xiong memorialized, saying, "The Nine Ministers rank next to the three duties and are classed among great ministers; in walking they have the ritual of jade pendants and in movement the ceremony of ranked precedence."

sentences.zh: 孝明皇帝始有撲罰，皆非古典。

translations.literal: "Emperor Ming first had beating punishment—none of this is ancient canon."
translations.idiomatic: "Emperor Ming first had beating punishment—none of this is ancient canon."

sentences.zh: 」帝納之，是後九卿無復捶撲者。

translations.literal: The Emperor accepted it; thereafter the Nine Ministers were no longer beaten and flogged.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted it; thereafter the Nine Ministers were no longer beaten and flogged.

sentences.zh: 戊午，司空王龔免。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Minister of Works Wang Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Minister of Works Wang Gong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月，辛未，以太常魯國孔扶為司空。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinwei day, made Director of Ceremonies Kong Fu of Lu Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinwei day, Director of Ceremonies Kong Fu of Lu was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，洛陽宣德亭地坼，長八十五丈；

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the ground split at Xuande pavilion in Luoyang, eighty-five zhang long;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the ground split at Xuande pavilion in Luoyang, eighty-five zhang long;

sentences.zh: 帝引公卿所舉敦樸之士，使之對策，及特問以當世之敝，為政所宜。

translations.literal: the Emperor summoned the plain and honest gentlemen recommended by dukes and ministers, had them answer policy questions, and specially asked about present-day ills and what government should do.
translations.idiomatic: the Emperor summoned the plain and honest gentlemen recommended by dukes and ministers, had them answer policy questions, and specially asked about present-day ills and what government should do.

sentences.zh: 李固對曰：「前孝安皇帝變亂舊典，封爵阿母，因造妖孽，改亂嫡嗣，至令聖躬狼狽，親遇其艱。

translations.literal: Li Gu replied, saying: "Formerly Emperor An overturned old canons, enfeoffed the foster mother, thereby creating prodigies, altered and confused the legitimate heir, until the sage person was in distress and personally met hardship."
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu replied, saying, "Formerly Emperor An overturned old canons, enfeoffed the foster mother, thereby creating prodigies, and altered and confused the legitimate heir, until Your Majesty was in distress and personally met hardship."

sentences.zh: 既拔自困殆，龍興即位，天下喁喁，屬望風政。

translations.literal: "Having been raised from peril, the dragon arose and took the throne; all under heaven murmured and looked to your wind in government."
translations.idiomatic: "Having been raised from peril, you arose and took the throne; all under heaven murmured and looked to your governance."

sentences.zh: 積敝之後，易致中興，誠當沛然思惟善道，而論者猶云『方今之事，復同於前』。

translations.literal: "After accumulated ills, renewal is easy to bring—truly one should abundantly think on the good Way, yet debaters still say 'affairs today are again the same as before.'"
translations.idiomatic: "After accumulated ills, renewal is easy to bring—truly one should abundantly think on the good Way, yet debaters still say 'affairs today are again the same as before.'"

sentences.zh: 臣伏在草澤，痛心傷臆！

translations.literal: "Your servant lies low in grass and marsh, heart pained and breast wounded!"
translations.idiomatic: "Your servant lies low in grass and marsh, heart pained and breast wounded!"

sentences.zh: 實以漢興以來三百餘年，賢聖相繼十有八主，豈無阿乳之恩，豈忘貴爵之寵？

translations.literal: "Truly since Han rose more than three hundred years, worthy sages succeeding one another for eighteen rulers—was there no foster-mother affection, was noble rank's favor forgotten?"
translations.idiomatic: "Truly since Han rose more than three hundred years, worthy sages succeeding one another through eighteen rulers—was there no foster-mother affection? Was noble rank's favor forgotten?"

sentences.zh: 然上畏天威，俯案經典，知義不可，故不封也。

translations.literal: "Yet they revered Heaven's majesty above, bowed to the classics below, knew righteousness forbade it, and therefore did not enfeoff."
translations.idiomatic: "Yet they revered Heaven's majesty above, bowed to the classics below, knew righteousness forbade it, and therefore did not enfeoff."

sentences.zh: 今宋阿母雖有大功、勤謹之德，但加賞賜，足以酬其勞苦；

translations.literal: "Now Foster Mother Song, though she has great merit and diligent, careful virtue—only add rewards and gifts, enough to repay her toil;"
translations.idiomatic: "Now Foster Mother Song, though she has great merit and diligent, careful virtue—only add rewards and gifts, enough to repay her toil;"

sentences.zh: 至於裂土開國，實乖舊典。

translations.literal: "as for splitting land and opening a state, it truly violates old canon."
translations.idiomatic: "as for splitting land and opening a state, it truly violates old canon."

sentences.zh: 聞阿母體性謙虛，必有遜讓，陛下宜許其辭國之高，使成萬安之福。

translations.literal: "I hear the foster mother's nature is modest—she will surely yield; Your Majesty should permit her lofty refusal of a state and thereby complete the blessing of ten thousand peace."
translations.idiomatic: "I hear the foster mother's nature is modest—she will surely yield. Your Majesty should permit her lofty refusal of a state and thereby secure the blessing of lasting peace."

sentences.zh: 夫妃、後之家所以少完全者，豈天性當然？

translations.literal: "That consort and empress families rarely end whole—is it their nature that it must be so?"
translations.idiomatic: "That consort and empress families rarely end whole—is it their nature that it must be so?"

sentences.zh: 但以爵位尊顯，顓總權柄，天道惡盈，不知自損，故致顛仆。

translations.literal: "Only because rank and position are exalted, they monopolize authority; Heaven's Way hates fullness—they do not know self-reduction, and therefore fall."
translations.idiomatic: "Only because rank and position are exalted, they monopolize authority. Heaven's Way hates fullness—they do not know self-reduction, and therefore fall."

sentences.zh: 先帝寵遇閻氏，位號太疾，故其受禍曾不旋時，《老子》曰：『其進銳者其退速也。

translations.literal: "The former emperor favored the Yan clan, rank and title too swift—thus their receiving calamity did not wait a turn of the hour. Laozi says: 'What advances sharply retreats swiftly.'"
translations.idiomatic: "The former emperor favored the Yan clan and advanced rank and title too swiftly—thus their receiving calamity did not wait a turn of the hour. Laozi says, 'What advances sharply retreats swiftly.'"

sentences.zh: 』今梁氏戚為椒房，禮所不臣，尊以高爵，尚可然也；

translations.literal: "Now the Liang clan as kin of the inner chamber are what ritual does not make subjects—honoring them with high rank can still be so;"
translations.idiomatic: "Now the Liang clan as kin of the inner chamber are what ritual does not make subjects—honoring them with high rank can still be acceptable;"

sentences.zh: 而子弟群從，榮顯兼加，永平、建初故事，殆不如此。

translations.literal: "yet sons, younger brothers, and the whole lineage together add glory and display—the precedents of Yongping and Jianchu scarcely went this far."
translations.idiomatic: "yet sons, younger brothers, and the whole lineage together add glory and display—the precedents of Yongping and Jianchu scarcely went this far."

sentences.zh: 宜令步兵校尉冀及諸侍中還居黃門之官，使權去外戚，政歸國家，豈不休乎！

translations.literal: It would be fitting to have Infantry Commandant Ji and the various Palace Attendants return to their Yellow Gate offices, so that power leaves the maternal kin and government returns to the state—would that not be excellent!
translations.idiomatic: It would be fitting to have Infantry Commandant Liang Ji and the various Palace Attendants return to their Yellow Gate offices, so that power leaves the maternal kin and government returns to the state—would that not be excellent!

sentences.zh: 又，詔書所以禁侍中、尚書、中臣子弟不得為吏、察孝廉者，以其秉威權，容請托故也。

translations.literal: Moreover, the reason edicts forbid sons of Palace Attendants, Directors of the Secretariat, and inner eunuchs from holding office or being nominated as Filial and Incorrupt is that they wield authority and favor and accept private requests.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, edicts forbid sons of Palace Attendants, Directors of the Secretariat, and inner eunuchs from holding office or being nominated as Filial and Incorrupt because they wield authority and accept private requests.

sentences.zh: 而中常侍在日月之側，聲勢振天下，子弟祿任，曾無限極，雖外托謙默，不干州郡，而諂偽之徒，望風進舉。

translations.literal: Yet the Regular Palace Attendants stand beside the sun and moon; their voices and power shake all under heaven; their sons and younger kin receive salaries and appointments without limit. Though outwardly they profess humility and do not meddle in the provinces, flatterers and frauds advance at the wind of their reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Regular Palace Attendants stand beside the throne; their voices and power shake all under heaven, and their sons and younger kin receive salaries and appointments without limit. Though outwardly they profess humility and do not meddle in the provinces, flatterers and frauds advance at the wind of their reputation.

sentences.zh: 今可為設常禁，同之中臣。

translations.literal: Now one may set a standing prohibition, applying the same rule to inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Now one may set a standing prohibition, applying the same rule to inner eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 昔館陶公主為子求郎，明帝不許，賜錢千萬，所以輕厚賜，重薄位者，為官人失才，害及百姓也。

translations.literal: Formerly when Princess Guantao sought a Gentleman rank for her son, Emperor Ming did not grant it but gave ten million cash—the reason heavy thick gifts were used to value thin offices lightly was that placing the unworthy in office harms the people.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Princess Guantao sought a Gentleman rank for her son, Emperor Ming refused but gave ten million cash—the reason he lavished gifts yet withheld office lightly was that placing the unworthy in office harms the people.

sentences.zh: 竊聞長水司馬武宣、開陽城門候羊迪等，無它功德，初拜便真，此雖小失而漸壞舊章。

translations.literal: I have heard that Commander of the Chang River Wu Xuan, Gatekeeper of Kaiyang Yang Di, and others, without other merit or virtue, upon first appointment received full regular salary—though a small lapse, it gradually ruins the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that Commander of the Chang River Wu Xuan, Gatekeeper of Kaiyang Yang Di, and others, without other merit or virtue, upon first appointment received full regular salary—though a small lapse, it gradually ruins the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 先聖法度，所宜堅守，故政教一跌，百年不復。

translations.literal: The laws and institutions of the former sages ought to be firmly held; once government and teaching stumble, a hundred years will not restore them.
translations.idiomatic: The laws and institutions of the former sages ought to be firmly held; once government and teaching stumble, a hundred years will not restore them.

sentences.zh: 《詩》云：『上帝板板，下民卒癉』，刺周王變祖法度，故使下民將盡病也。

translations.literal: The Odes says: "High God is topsy-turvy, the lower people will utterly sicken"—criticizing the Zhou king for changing ancestral law, causing the people below to be nearly all ill.
translations.idiomatic: The Odes says, "High God is topsy-turvy, the lower people will utterly sicken"—criticizing the Zhou king for changing ancestral law and causing the people below to be nearly all ill.

sentences.zh: 今陛下之有尚書，猶天之有北斗也。

translations.literal: Now that Your Majesty has Directors of the Secretariat is like heaven having the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: That Your Majesty has Directors of the Secretariat is like heaven having the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 斗為天喉舌，尚書亦為陛下喉舌。

translations.literal: The Dipper is heaven's throat and tongue; the Directors are also Your Majesty's throat and tongue.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper is heaven's throat and tongue; the Directors are also Your Majesty's throat and tongue.

sentences.zh: 斗斟酌元氣，運乎四時；

translations.literal: The Dipper measures out primordial qi and moves through the four seasons;
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper measures out primordial qi and moves through the four seasons;

sentences.zh: 尚書出納王命，賦政四海，權尊勢重，責之所歸，若不平心，災眚必至，誠宜審擇其人，以毘聖政。

translations.literal: Directors receive and issue the king's commands and assign government to the four seas—with exalted authority and heavy power, responsibility rests on them; if they do not balance their hearts, calamities must come—truly one should carefully choose such men to assist sage government.
translations.idiomatic: Directors receive and issue the king's commands and assign government to the four seas. With exalted authority and heavy power, responsibility rests on them; if they do not balance their hearts, calamities must come—Your Majesty should carefully choose such men to assist sage government.

sentences.zh: 今與陛下共天下者，外則公、卿、尚書，內則常侍、黃門，譬猶一門之內，一家之事，安則共其福慶，危則通其禍敗。

translations.literal: Those who today share the realm with Your Majesty are outwardly the Excellencies, Directors, inwardly the Regular Attendants and Yellow Gate—as in one gate's household, one family's affairs; in peace they share fortune and blessing, in danger they share misfortune and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Those who today share the realm with Your Majesty are outwardly the Excellencies and Directors, inwardly the Regular Attendants and Yellow Gate—as in one household within one gate; in peace they share fortune and blessing, in danger they share misfortune and ruin.

sentences.zh: 刺史、二千石，外統職事，內受法則。

translations.literal: Inspectors and the two-thousand-dan officials outwardly oversee official duties, inwardly receive law and norms.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors and the two-thousand-dan officials outwardly oversee official duties and inwardly receive law and norms.

sentences.zh: 夫表曲者景必邪，源清者流必潔，猶叩樹本，百枝皆動也。

translations.literal: When the gnomon's shadow is crooked the image must be slant; when the source is clear the stream must be pure—like knocking the tree's trunk, a hundred branches all move.
translations.idiomatic: When the sundial's shadow is crooked the image must be slant; when the source is clear the stream must be pure—like knocking the tree's trunk, a hundred branches all move.

sentences.zh: 由此言之，本朝號令，豈可蹉跌！

translations.literal: From this it is said: can the court's orders and proclamations stumble!
translations.idiomatic: From this it follows: can the court's orders and proclamations stumble!

sentences.zh: 天下之紀綱，當今之急務也。

translations.literal: The cords and net of all under heaven are the urgent business of the present age.
translations.idiomatic: The cords and net of all under heaven are the urgent business of the present age.

sentences.zh: 夫人君之有政，猶水之有堤坊。

translations.literal: When a lord has government it is like water having dikes and embankments.
translations.idiomatic: When a lord has government it is like water having dikes and embankments.

sentences.zh: 堤坊完全，雖遭雨水霖潦，不能為變。

translations.literal: When dikes are complete, though encountering great rain and flood, it cannot change.
translations.idiomatic: When dikes are complete, though great rain and flood come, they cannot change it.

sentences.zh: 政教一立，暫遭凶年，不足為憂。

translations.literal: Once government and teaching are established, though temporarily meeting a bad year, it is insufficient for worry.
translations.idiomatic: Once government and teaching are established, though a bad year comes temporarily, it is not worth worry.

sentences.zh: 誠令堤防穿漏，萬夫同力，不能復救；

translations.literal: Truly if the dike defenses are pierced and leaking, ten thousand men with united strength cannot rescue;
translations.idiomatic: Truly if the dike defenses are pierced and leaking, ten thousand men with united strength cannot rescue them;

sentences.zh: 政教一壞，賢智馳鶩，不能復還。

translations.literal: once government and teaching are ruined, the worthy and wise scatter in flight and cannot return.
translations.idiomatic: once government and teaching are ruined, the worthy and wise scatter in flight and cannot return.

sentences.zh: 今堤防雖堅，漸有孔穴。

translations.literal: Now the dike defenses though solid gradually have holes and cracks.
translations.idiomatic: Now the dike defenses, though solid, gradually have holes and cracks.

sentences.zh: 譬之一人之身，本朝者，心腹也，州、郡者，四支也，心腹痛則四支不舉。

translations.literal: It is like one person's body—the court is the heart and belly, the provinces and commanderies are the four limbs; when heart and belly are in pain the four limbs do not lift.
translations.idiomatic: It is like one person's body—the court is the heart and belly, the provinces and commanderies are the four limbs; when heart and belly are in pain the four limbs do not lift.

sentences.zh: 故臣之所憂，在腹心之疾，非四支之患也。

translations.literal: Thus what your servant worries about is disease of heart and belly, not ailment of the four limbs.
translations.idiomatic: Thus what your servant worries about is disease of heart and belly, not ailment of the four limbs.

sentences.zh: 苟堅堤防，務政教，先安心腹，整理本朝，雖有寇賊、水旱之變，不足介意也；

translations.literal: If one firmly builds dikes, devotes effort to government and teaching, first securing heart and belly and putting the court in order, though there be bandits and flood or drought changes, it is not worth minding;
translations.idiomatic: If one firmly builds dikes, devotes effort to government and teaching, first secures heart and belly and puts the court in order, though bandits and flood or drought come, it is not worth minding;

sentences.zh: 誠令堤防壞漏，心腹有疾，雖無水旱之災，天下固可以憂矣。

translations.literal: truly if dike defenses break and leak and heart and belly have disease, though there be no flood or drought disaster, the realm can still be worried over.
translations.idiomatic: truly if dike defenses break and leak and heart and belly have disease, though there is no flood or drought disaster, the realm can still be cause for worry.

sentences.zh: 又宜罷退宦官，去其權重，裁置常侍二人方直有德者省事左右，小黃門五人才智閑雅者給事殿中。

translations.literal: Further one should dismiss and demote eunuchs, remove their heavy authority, limit to two Regular Palace Attendants of upright square virtue handling affairs at left and right, five Junior Yellow Gate men of talent, wisdom, leisure, and elegance serving in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Further one should dismiss and demote eunuchs and remove their heavy authority, limiting Regular Palace Attendants to two upright men of virtue handling affairs at left and right, and five Junior Yellow Gate men of talent, wisdom, and refined manner to serve in the hall.

sentences.zh: 如此，則論者厭塞，昇平可致也！

translations.literal: Thus disputants would be satisfied and stopped, and ascending peace could be attained!
translations.idiomatic: Thus disputants would be satisfied and stopped, and an age of ascending peace could be attained!

sentences.zh: 扶風功曹馬融對曰：「今科條品制，四時禁令，所以承天順民者，備矣，悉矣，不可加矣。

translations.literal: Ma Rong, Merit Officer of Fufeng, replied: "Now statutes and grades, the four seasons' prohibitions, what receives heaven and accords with the people—all is provided, all is complete, nothing can be added.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Rong, Merit Officer of Fufeng, replied, "Now statutes and grades and the four seasons' prohibitions—what receives heaven and accords with the people—is all provided and complete; nothing can be added.

sentences.zh: 然而天猶有不平之效，民猶有咨嗟之怨者，百姓屢聞恩澤之聲，而未見惠和之實也。

translations.literal: Yet heaven still has unbalanced effects, the people still have sighing complaints—the common people often hear the sound of grace but do not see the substance of benefit and harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Yet heaven still shows imbalance, and the people still sigh in complaint—the common people often hear the sound of grace but do not see the substance of benefit and harmony.

sentences.zh: 古之足民者，非能家贍而人足之，量其財用，為之制度。

translations.literal: Those of antiquity who made the people sufficient did not make every household rich so every man was full—they measured out resources and expenditure and made institutions for them.
translations.idiomatic: Those of antiquity who made the people sufficient did not make every household rich so every man was full—they measured resources and expenditure and made institutions for them.

sentences.zh: 故嫁娶之禮儉，則婚者以時矣；
