translations.literal: Thus if marriage rites were frugal, those marrying did so in season;
translations.idiomatic: Thus if marriage rites were frugal, those marrying did so in season;

sentences.zh: 喪制之禮約，則終者掩藏矣；

translations.literal: if mourning rites were restrained, those dying were buried and concealed;
translations.idiomatic: if mourning rites were restrained, the dead were buried and concealed;

sentences.zh: 不奪其時，則農夫利矣。

translations.literal: if their seasons were not seized, farmers profited.
translations.idiomatic: if their seasons were not seized, farmers profited.

sentences.zh: 夫妻子以累其心，產業以重其志，捨此而為非者，有必不多矣！

translations.literal: Wife and children to burden the heart, property and estates to weigh the ambition—abandon this and do wrong and there cannot be many!
translations.idiomatic: Wife and children burden the heart and property and estates weigh the ambition—abandon this and do wrong and there cannot be many!

sentences.zh: 太史令南陽張衡對曰：「自初舉孝廉，迄今二百歲矣，皆先孝行；

translations.literal: Grand Clerk Zhang Heng of Nanyang replied: "Since the first raising of Filial and Incorrupt, to now two hundred years have passed—all first had filial conduct;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Clerk Zhang Heng of Nanyang replied, "Since the first raising of Filial and Incorrupt, two hundred years have passed—all first required filial conduct;

sentences.zh: 行有餘力，始學文法。

translations.literal: when conduct had surplus strength, only then they studied literary law.
translations.idiomatic: when conduct had surplus strength, only then they studied literary law.

sentences.zh: 辛卯詔書，以能章句、奏案為限；

translations.literal: The xinmao edict took ability at clause commentary and memorial drafting as the limit;
translations.idiomatic: The xinmao edict took ability at clause commentary and memorial drafting as the limit;

sentences.zh: 雖有至孝，猶不應科，此棄本而取末。

translations.literal: though there was utmost filial piety, still they did not meet the category—this abandons root and takes branch.
translations.idiomatic: though there was utmost filial piety, still they did not meet the category—this abandons root and takes branch.

sentences.zh: 曾子長於孝，然實魯鈍，文學不若游、夏，政事不若冉、季。

translations.literal: Zengzi excelled in filial piety but was truly dull in Lu; literary studies not like You or Xia, government affairs not like Ran or Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Zengzi excelled in filial piety but was truly dull in Lu; in literary studies he did not match You or Xia, in government affairs he did not match Ran or Ji.

sentences.zh: 今欲使一人兼之，苟外有可觀，內必有闕，則違選舉孝廉之志矣。

translations.literal: Now wishing one man to combine all—if outwardly there is something to view, inwardly there must be lacks—then it violates the intent of selecting Filial and Incorrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Now wishing one man to combine all—if outwardly there is something to view, inwardly there must be lacks—then it violates the intent of selecting Filial and Incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 且郡國守相，剖符寧境，為國大臣，一旦免黜十有餘人，吏民罷於送迎之役，新故交際，公私放濫，或臨政為百姓所便而以小過免之，是為奪民父母使嗟號也。

translations.literal: Moreover the commandery and state governors and chancellors, splitting tallies and securing the border as great ministers of the state—once more than ten were dismissed; clerks and people were exhausted by seeing-off and receiving duties; new and old alternated, public and private overflowed—some were convenient to the people in governing yet dismissed for small faults—that is seizing the people's parents and making them wail.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the commandery and state governors and chancellors, who split tallies and secure the border as great ministers of the state—once more than ten were dismissed at a stroke. Clerks and people were exhausted by seeing-off and receiving duties; new and old alternated and public and private affairs overflowed. Some who governed conveniently for the people were dismissed for small faults—that is seizing the people's parents and making them wail.

sentences.zh: 《易》不遠復，《論》不憚改，朋友交接且不宿過，況於帝王，承天理物，以天下為公者乎！

translations.literal: The Changes says not distant from restoration, the Analects says not fearing to change—friends in contact do not even lodge overnight over faults—how much more the Son of Heaven, receiving heaven's principle and things, taking the realm as public!
translations.idiomatic: The Changes says not distant from restoration, the Analects says not fearing to change—even friends in contact do not lodge overnight over faults. How much more the Son of Heaven, who receives heaven's principle and governs things and takes the realm as public!

sentences.zh: 中間以來，妖星見於上，震裂著於下，天誡詳矣，可為寒心。

translations.literal: In the interval prodigious stars have appeared above, earthquakes and cracks shown below—heaven's warning is detailed; one may feel cold at heart.
translations.idiomatic: In the interval prodigious stars have appeared above and earthquakes and cracks below—heaven's warning is detailed and should make one feel cold at heart.

sentences.zh: 明者消禍於未萌。

translations.literal: The enlightened extinguish calamity before it sprouts.
translations.idiomatic: The enlightened extinguish calamity before it sprouts.

sentences.zh: 今既見矣，修政恐懼，則禍轉為福矣。

translations.literal: Now that it has been seen, to repair government in fear and dread—then calamity turns to blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Now that it has been seen, to repair government in fear and dread—then calamity turns to blessing.

sentences.zh: 上覽眾對，以李固為第一，即時出阿母還捨，諸常侍悉叩頭謝罪，朝廷肅然。

translations.literal: The Emperor reviewed the various replies, ranked Li Gu first, immediately sent the foster mother back to her quarters, all Regular Palace Attendants kowtowed begging pardon, and the court was solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reviewed the various replies and ranked Li Gu first. He immediately sent the foster mother back to her quarters; all Regular Palace Attendants kowtowed begging pardon, and the court was solemn.

sentences.zh: 以固為議郎；

translations.literal: Made Gu Remonstrating Censor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu was made Remonstrating Censor;

sentences.zh: 而阿母、宦者皆疾之，詐為飛章以陷其罪。

translations.literal: yet the foster mother and eunuchs all hated him, fabricating flying memorials to trap him in guilt.
translations.idiomatic: yet the foster mother and eunuchs all hated him and fabricated anonymous memorials to trap him in guilt.

sentences.zh: 事從中下，大司農南郡黃尚等請之於梁商，僕射黃瓊復救明其事。

translations.literal: The matter followed the palace attendant's downward transmission; Grand Minister of Agriculture Huang Shang of Nan commandery and others requested on his behalf from Liang Shang, Vice Director Huang Qiong again clarified the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The matter followed the palace attendant's secret channel downward. Grand Minister of Agriculture Huang Shang of Nan commandery and others pleaded on his behalf to Liang Shang, and Vice Director Huang Qiong again clarified the matter.

sentences.zh: 久乃得釋，出為洛令，固棄官歸漢中。

translations.literal: Only after long time was he released, sent out as Magistrate of Luo—Gu abandoned office and returned to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Only after a long time was he released and sent out as Magistrate of Luo. Gu abandoned office and returned to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 融博通經籍，美文辭；

translations.literal: Rong was broadly versed in the classics, fine in literary compositions;
translations.idiomatic: Rong was broadly versed in the classics and fine in literary composition;

sentences.zh: 對奏，亦拜議郎。

translations.literal: for his reply memorial he was also made Remonstrating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: for his reply memorial he was also made Remonstrating Censor.

sentences.zh: 衡善屬文，通貫《六藝》，雖才高於世，而無驕尚之情；

translations.literal: Heng was skilled at literary composition, thoroughly mastered the Six Arts—though talent higher than the age, without arrogant esteeming disposition;
translations.idiomatic: Heng was skilled at literary composition and thoroughly mastered the Six Arts. Though his talent surpassed the age, he had no arrogant disposition;

sentences.zh: 善機巧，尤致思於天文、陰陽、歷算，作渾天儀，著《靈憲》。

translations.literal: skilled in ingenious devices, especially applying thought to astronomy, yin-yang, calendars and reckoning, made the armillary sphere, wrote Ling Xian.
translations.idiomatic: he was skilled in ingenious devices and especially applied thought to astronomy, yin-yang, and calendrical reckoning; he made the armillary sphere and wrote Ling Xian.

sentences.zh: 性恬憺，不慕當世；

translations.literal: Nature tranquil and shallow, not admiring the present age;
translations.idiomatic: His nature was tranquil and unassuming; he did not court the present age;

sentences.zh: 所居之官輒積年不徙。

translations.literal: whatever office he held, for years he was not transferred.
translations.idiomatic: whatever office he held, for years he was not transferred.

sentences.zh: 太尉寵參，在三公中最名忠直，數為左右所毀。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Dou Chong, among the Three Excellencies most famed for loyalty and straightness, was repeatedly slandered by those at the left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Dou Chong, among the Three Excellencies most famed for loyalty and straightness, was repeatedly slandered by those at the Emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 會所舉用忤帝旨，司隸承風案之。

translations.literal: It happened that those he recommended and employed went against the Emperor's intent; the Director of the Secretariat followed the wind and investigated him.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that those he recommended went against the Emperor's intent; the Director of the Secretariat followed the wind and investigated him.

sentences.zh: 時當會茂才、孝廉，參以被奏，稱疾不會。

translations.literal: At the time it was time to convene Outstanding Talents and Filial and Incorrupt—Chong because impeached claimed illness and did not attend.
translations.idiomatic: At the time it was time to convene Outstanding Talents and Filial and Incorrupt. Chong, because he had been impeached, claimed illness and did not attend.

sentences.zh: 廣漢上計掾段恭因會上疏曰：「伏見道路行人、農夫、織婦皆曰：『太尉參竭忠盡節，徒以直道不能曲心，孤立群邪之間，自處中傷之地。

translations.literal: Duan Gong, reporting clerk of Guanghan at the annual accounting, took advantage to memorialize: "I see travelers on the road, farmers, weaving women all say: 'Grand Commandant Chong exhausts loyalty and utmost integrity, only because the straight way cannot bend his heart, standing alone among the throng of evils, placing himself in the ground of injury.'"
translations.idiomatic: Duan Gong, reporting clerk of Guanghan at the annual accounting, took advantage to memorialize, saying, "I see travelers on the road, farmers, and weaving women all say, 'Grand Commandant Dou Chong exhausts loyalty and utmost integrity, only because the straight way cannot bend his heart. He stands alone among the throng of evils and places himself where he will be injured.'"

sentences.zh: 』夫以讒佞傷毀忠正，此天地之大禁，人主之至誡也！

translations.literal: " To use slanderous flatterers to injure and destroy the loyal and upright—this is the great prohibition of Heaven and Earth, the utmost warning of the lord!
translations.idiomatic: " To use slanderous flatterers to injure and destroy the loyal and upright—this is the great prohibition of Heaven and Earth and the utmost warning for a lord!

sentences.zh: 昔白起賜死，諸侯酌酒相賀；

translations.literal: Formerly when Bai Qi was granted death, the feudal lords raised cups and toasted one another in congratulation;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Bai Qi was granted death, the feudal lords raised cups and toasted one another in congratulation;

sentences.zh: 季子來歸，魯人喜其紓難。

translations.literal: when Jizi returned, the men of Lu rejoiced that their difficulty was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: when Jizi returned, the men of Lu rejoiced that their difficulty was relieved.

sentences.zh: 夫國以賢治，君以忠安。

translations.literal: The state is governed by the worthy, the lord is secured by the loyal.
translations.idiomatic: The state is governed by the worthy; the lord is secured by the loyal.

sentences.zh: 今天下咸欣陛下有此忠賢，願卒寵任以安社稷。

translations.literal: Now all under heaven rejoice that Your Majesty has this loyal worthy—we wish you finally favor and entrust him to secure the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: Now all under heaven rejoice that Your Majesty has this loyal worthy. We wish you finally to favor and entrust him to secure the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 」書奏，詔即遣小黃門視參疾，太醫致羊酒。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; an edict immediately sent Junior Yellow Gate to visit Chong's illness, the imperial physician presented lamb and wine.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted. An edict immediately sent a Junior Yellow Gate to visit Chong's illness, and the imperial physician presented lamb and wine.

sentences.zh: 後參夫人疾前妻子，投於井而殺之；

translations.literal: Later Chong's wife fell ill; his former wife—he threw her in a well and killed her;
translations.idiomatic: Later when Chong's wife fell ill, he threw his former wife into a well and killed her;

sentences.zh: 雒陽令祝良奏參罪。

translations.literal: Magistrate of Luoyang Zhu Liang memorialized Chong's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate of Luoyang Zhu Liang memorialized Chong's crime.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，己未，參竟以災異免。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiwei day, Chong in the end was dismissed because of prodigies and anomalies.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on jiwei day, Chong was in the end dismissed because of prodigies and anomalies.

sentences.zh: 八月，己巳，以大鴻臚施延為太尉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jisi day, made Minister Herald Shi Yan Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, Minister Herald Shi Yan was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑寇馬城，代郡太守擊之，不克。

translations.literal: The Xianbei raided Ma Castle; Administrator of Dai commandery struck them but did not overcome.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei raided Ma Castle. The Administrator of Dai commandery struck them but did not overcome them.

sentences.zh: 頃之，其至鞬死。

translations.literal: Before long their chanyu died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long their chanyu died.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑由是抄盜差稀。

translations.literal: The Xianbei thereby had raids and thefts comparatively rare.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei thereby raided and plundered somewhat less.
